'd.meaning: abbr. colloq. (usu. after pronouns) had, would ◊ I'd ◊ he'd [缩略] [口] (通常用在代词后）用于代替 had 或 would

'em.meaning: pron. colloq. them [口]他（她）们，它们 ◊ let 'em all come 让他们都来吧

'll.meaning: abbr. colloq. (usu. after pronouns 通常用于代词后) shall, will [缩略] [口]将，要 ◊ I'll 我要 ◊ that'll 那将

'm.meaning: 1 abbr. colloq. [缩略] [口] am ◊ I'm sorry 对不起 'm 2 n. colloq. madam (in yes'm etc.) [口]夫人，太太（用于 yes'm 等表达法中)

'mongst.meaning: poet. var. of AMONGST [诗] AMONGST 的变体 (see 见 AMONG )

'n.meaning: conj. (also 亦作 'n' ) colloq. [口] and 和，与

're.meaning: abbr. colloq. (usu. after pronouns) are [缩略] [口] (通常用于代词后）是 ◊ we're 我们是 ◊ you're 你（们）是

's.phonetic: /s, z after a vowel sound or voiced consonant 在元音或浊辅音前读 z/
's.meaning: abbr. colloq. [缩略] [口] 1. is, has ◊ he's arrived 他已经到达 ◊ it's raining 正在下雨 ◊ John's late 约翰来晚了 2. us ◊ let's 让我们… 3. does ◊ what's he say? 他说什么？

's-.phonetic: /s, z before a voiced consonant 在浊辅音后读 z/
's-.meaning: prefix archaic (esp. in oaths) God's [古义] (尤指在誓言中) 上帝的 ◊ 's blood 上帝的血 ◊ 's trewth 上帝的真理

'tween-decks.meaning: n. pl. Naut. the space between decks 【海】 （两层甲板之间的）中间甲板，甲板间

'un.meaning: pron. colloq. one [口]一个 ◊ that's a good 'un 那个可真好

've.meaning: abbr. [缩略] colloq. [口] (usu. after pronouns 通常位于代词之后) have (I've, they've)

-'s.phonetic: /s, z after a vowel sound or voiced consonant 在元音或浊辅音后读 z, iz after a sibilant 在咝音后读 iz/
-'s.meaning: 1 /s, z after a vowel sound or voiced consonant 在元音或浊辅音后读 z, iz after a sibilant 在咝音后读 iz/ suffix denoting the possessive case of singular nouns and of plural nouns not ending in -s 在不以 s 结尾的单、复数名词后表示所有格 ◊ John's book 约翰的书 ◊ the book's cover 书的封皮 ◊ the children's shoes 孩子们的鞋 ◊ Mr Jones's dog 琼斯先生的狗 -'s 2 /s, z after a vowel sound or voiced consonant 在元音或浊辅音后读 z, iz after a sibilant 在咝音后读 iz/ suffix denoting the plural of a letter or symbol 表示字母或符号的复数 ◊ S's; 8's

-a.meaning: 1 /ə/ suffix forming nouns from Greek, Latin, and Romanic feminine singular, esp. 构成源自希腊、拉丁和罗曼语的阴性单数名词，（尤指): 1. ancient or Latinized modern names of animals and plants 动植物的古名或现代拉丁名 ◊ amoeba 变形虫 ◊ campanula 风铃草属植物 2. oxides 氧化物 ◊ alumina 矾土 3. geographical names 地理名称 ◊ Africa 非洲 4. ancient or Latinized modern feminine names 女子古名或现代拉丁名 ◊ Lydia 莉迪亚 ◊ Hilda 希尔达 -a 2 /ə/ suffix forming plural nouns from Greek and Latin neuter plural, esp. corresponding to a singular in -um or -on 构成源自希腊或拉丁语的中性复数名词，尤其是与 -um 或 -on 单数形式对应的 ◊ addenda 附录 ◊ phenomena 现象 ; and in names (often from modern Latin) of zoological groups （来自现代拉丁语的）动物学分类名称 ◊ Carnivora 食肉类 -a 3 /ə/ suffix colloq. [口] 1. of 相当于 of ◊ kinda ; coupla = kind of ; couple of 2. have 相当于 have ◊ mighta ; coulda = might have ; could have 3. to 相当于 to ◊ oughta = ought to

-ability.meaning: suffix forming nouns of quality from, or corresponding to, adjectives in -able (用于后缀为 -able 的形容词）构成名词，表示该形容词所指的或与之相一致的性质 ◊ capability 能力 ◊ vulnerability 弱点

-able.meaning: suffix forming adjectives meaning 构成形容词，意为 : 1. that may or must be 可以…的；必须…的 ◊ eatable 可食用的 ◊ forgiveable 可原谅的 ◊ payable 应支付的 2. that can be made the subject of 可作为…对象的 ◊ dutiable 应纳税的 ◊ objectionable 有异议的 3. that is relevant to or in accordance with 与…相关的，根据…的 ◊ fashionable 时髦的 ◊ seasonable 合季节的 4. (with active sense, in earlier word-formations) that may (具有积极意义的，早期合成词）可以…的 ◊ comfortable 舒服的 ◊ suitable 合适的

-ably.meaning: suffix forming adverbs corresponding to adjectives in -able 构成对应 -able 形式的形容词的副词

-ac.meaning: suffix forming adjectives which are often also (or only) used as nouns 用于构成亦可作为名词的形容词（有些只作名词) ◊ cardiac, maniac (see also 另见 -ACAL )

-acal.meaning: suffix forming adjectives, often used to distinguish them from nouns in -ac 构成形容词，常用以区别以 -ac 结尾的名词 ◊ heliacal 太阳的 ◊ maniacal 疯狂的

-acea.meaning: suffix forming the plural names of orders and classes of animals 构成动物类别的复数 ◊ Crustacea 甲壳类 (cf. 参见 -ACEAN )

-aceae.meaning: suffix forming the plural names of families of plants (用于构成植物类别的复数) ◊ Rosaceae 蔷薇科

-acean.meaning: suffix 1. forming adjectives 构成形容词 = -ACEOUS 2. forming nouns as the sing. of names in -acea (构成以 -acea 结尾的名词的单数形式) ◊ crustacean 甲壳类

-aceous.meaning: suffix forming adjectives, esp. from nouns in -acea, -aceae 构成以 -acea 或 -aceae 结尾的名词的形容词形式 ◊ herbaceous 草本的 ◊ rosaceous 蔷薇科的

-acious.meaning: suffix forming adjectives meaning ‘inclined to, full of’ 构成形容词，意为“倾向于…的”；“充满…的” ◊ vivacious 活泼的 ◊ pugnacious 好斗的 ◊ voracious 贪婪的 ◊ capacious 容量大的

-acity.meaning: suffix forming nouns of quality or state corresponding to adjectives in -acious 构成以 -acious 结尾形容词的名词形式，表示质量或状态

-acy.meaning: suffix forming nouns of state or quality 构成表示状态或性质的名词 ◊ accuracy 精确度 ◊ piracy 盗版行为 ◊ supremacy 至高无上 , or an instance of it 或其实例 ◊ conspiracy 阴谋 ◊ fallacy 谬论 (see also 另见 -CRACY )

-ad.meaning: 1 /æd, əd/ suffix forming nouns 构成名词 : 1. in collective numerals 构成集合数词 ◊ myriad 无数 ◊ triad 三合一 2. in fem. patronymics 构成女性源于父名的姓 ◊ Dryad 森林女神 3. in names of poems and similar compositions 诗一类作品的名字 ◊ Iliad 《伊利亚特》 ◊ Dunciad 《群愚史诗》 ◊ jeremiad 《哀诉》 -ad 2 /əd/ suffix forming nouns 构成名词 ◊ ballad 歌谣 ◊ salad 色拉 (cf. 参见 -ADE 1 )

-ade.meaning: 1 /eid/ suffix forming nouns 构成名词 : 1. an action done 表示做出的行动 ◊ blockade 封锁 ◊ tirade 长篇大论 2. the body concerned in an action or process 表示行进中的整体 ◊ cavalcade 马队 3. the product or result of a material or action 表示材料或动作的结果 ◊ arcade 拱廊 ◊ lemonade 柠檬汁 ◊ masquerade 化妆舞会 -ade 2 /eid/ suffix forming nouns 构成名词 ◊ decade 十年 (cf. 参见 -AD 1 ) -ade 3 /eid/ suffix forming nouns 构成名词 : 1. = -ADE 1 ◊ brocade 织锦 2. a person concerned 有关的人 ◊ renegade 变节者

-ado.meaning: suffix forming nouns 构成名词 ◊ desperado 亡命徒 (cf. 参见 -ADE 3 )

-ae.meaning: suffix forming plural nouns, used in names of animal and plant families, tribes, etc. 构成动物及植物科、族名称的复数形式 ◊ Felidae 猫科 ◊ Rosaceae 蔷薇科 and instead of -as in the plural of many non-naturalized or unfamiliar nouns in -a derived from Latin or Greek 或代替 -as 构成以 -a 结尾的拉丁或希腊非中性或罕用名词的复数形式 ◊ larvae 幼虫 ◊ actiniae 海葵

-aemia.meaning: comb. form (also 亦作 -haemia /ˈhi:miə/, US [美] -emia , -hemia /ˈhi:miə/) forming nouns denoting that a substance is (esp. excessively) present in the blood [构词成分]表示血液中（尤指超量）含有某种物质 ◊ bacteriaemia 细菌血症 ◊ pyaemia 脓血症

-age.meaning: suffix forming nouns denoting 构成名词，表示 : 1. an action 动作 ◊ breakage 破坏 ◊ spillage 溢出 2. a condition or function 状态或功能 ◊ bondage 束缚 ◊ a peerage 贵族地位 3. an aggregate or number of 总体，集合 ◊ coverage 综述 ◊ the peerage 贵族 ◊ acreage 英亩数 4. fees payable for; the cost of using 费用，花费 ◊ postage 邮费 5. the product of an action 动作结果 ◊ dosage 用量 ◊ wreckage 破坏 6. a place; an abode 地点，处所 ◊ anchorage 停泊地点 ◊ orphanage 孤儿院 ◊ parsonage 牧师住所

-al.meaning: suffix 1. forming adjectives meaning ‘relating to, of the kind of’ 构成形容词，意为“与…有关”；“…类的” : a. from Latin or Greek words 拉丁或希腊词根 ◊ central 中央的 ◊ regimental 军团的 ◊ colossal 巨大的 ◊ tropical 热带的 (cf. 参见 -IAL , -ICAL ) b. from English nouns 英语名词词根 ◊ tidal 潮汐的 2. forming nouns, esp. of verbal action 构成（动作）名词 ◊ animal 动物 ◊ rival 竞争对手 ◊ arrival 到达 ◊ proposal 建议 ◊ trial 试验

-ales.meaning: suffix forming the plural names of orders of plants 用于构成植物种类名词的复数形式 ◊ Rosales 双子叶植物

-algia.meaning: comb. form Med. denoting pain in a part specified by the first element [构词成分] 【医】 表示“疼痛” ◊ neuralgia 神经痛 Phr & Deriv: -algic comb. form forming adjectives [构词成分]构成形容词

-algic.meaning: comb. form forming adjectives [构词成分]构成形容词 See main entry at -algia ----> -algia /ˈældʒə/ comb. form Med. denoting pain in a part specified by the first element [构词成分] 【医】 表示“疼痛” ◊ neuralgia 神经痛 Phr & Deriv: -algic comb. form forming adjectives [构词成分]构成形容词

-ally.meaning: suffix forming adverbs from adjectives in -al 用于以 al 结尾的形容词后面以构成副词 (cf. 参见 -AL , -LY 2 , -ICALLY )

-an.meaning: suffix 1. /(ə)n/ (also 亦作 -ean , -ian ) forming adjectives and nouns, esp. from names of places, systems, zoological classes or orders, and founders (尤用于某些地名、体系名、动物分类名、创始人名等）构成形容词或名词 ◊ Mexican 墨西哥的，墨西哥人 ◊ Anglican 英国国教的，英国国教徒 ◊ crustacean 甲壳类的，甲壳类 ◊ European 欧洲的，欧洲人 ◊ Lutheran 路德教会的，路德教会 ◊ Georgian 乔治亚的，乔治亚人 ◊ theologian 神学的，神学家 2. /æn/ Chem. forming names of organic compounds 【化】 构成有机化合物名 ◊ dextran 右旋糖苷

-ana.meaning: suffix forming plural nouns meaning ‘things associated with’ 构成复数名词，意为“与…有关的” ◊ Victoriana 有关维多利亚王朝的材料 ◊ Americana 有关美国的文献

-ance.meaning: suffix forming nouns expressing 构成名词，表示 : 1. a quality or state or an instance of one 特征、状态或事例 ◊ arrogance 傲慢 ◊ protuberance 隆起 ◊ relevance 相关性 ◊ resemblance 类似 2. an action 动作 ◊ assistance 协助 ◊ furtherance 促进 ◊ penance 忏悔

-ancy.meaning: suffix forming nouns denoting a quality 构成名词，表示性质 ◊ constancy 坚定不移 ◊ relevancy 相关性 or state 或状态 ◊ expectancy 期望 ◊ infancy 幼年 (cf. 参见 -ANCE )

-and.meaning: suffix forming nouns meaning ‘a person or thing to be treated in a specified way’ 构成名词，意为“被以某种方式对待的人（或物）” ◊ analysand 接受神经分析的人 ◊ ordinand 候补续任神职的人

-androus.meaning: comb. form Bot. forming adjectives meaning ‘having specified male organs or stamens’ [构词成分] 【植】 构成形容词，意为“具有某种雄性器官或雄蕊的” ◊ monandrous 单雄蕊的

-ane.meaning: 1 /ein/ suffix var. of -AN ; usu. with distinction of sense -AN 的变体；通常具有不同意义 ◊ germane 密切相关的 ◊ humane 仁慈的 ◊ urbane 彬彬有礼的 but sometimes with no corresponding form in -an 但有时没有 -an 的对应形式 ◊ mundane 世俗的 -ane 2 /ein/ suffix Chem. forming names of saturated hydrocarbons 【化】 构成饱和炭化氢类物质名词 ◊ methane 甲烷 ◊ propane 丙烷

-aneous.meaning: suffix forming adjectives 构成形容词 ◊ cutaneous 皮肤的 ◊ miscellaneous 各种的

-ant.meaning: suffix 1. forming adjectives denoting attribution of an action 构成形容词，表示动作的属性 ◊ pendant 下垂的 ◊ repentant 后悔的 or state 或表示状态 ◊ arrogant 傲慢的 ◊ expectant 预期的 2. forming nouns denoting an agent 构成施主名词 ◊ assistant 助手 ◊ celebrant 司仪神甫 ◊ deodorant 防臭剂

-ar.meaning: 1 /ə/ suffix 1. forming adjectives 构成形容词 ◊ angular 有角的 ◊ linear 线性的 ◊ nuclear 原子核的 ◊ titular 有名无实的 2. forming nouns 构成名词 ◊ scholar 学者 -ar 2 /ə/ suffix forming nouns 构成名词 ◊ pillar 柱子 -ar 3 /ə/ suffix forming nouns 构成名词 ◊ bursar 司库 ◊ exemplar 模范 ◊ mortar 研钵 ◊ vicar 教区牧师 -ar 4 /ə/ suffix assim. form of -ER 1 , -OR 1 -ER 1 ， -OR 1 的同化形式 ◊ liar 骗子 ◊ pedlar 小贩

-ard.meaning: suffix 1. forming nouns in depreciatory senses 构成贬义名词 ◊ drunkard 酒鬼 ◊ sluggard 懒鬼 2. forming nouns in other senses 构成其他含意的名词 ◊ bollard 系船柱 ◊ Spaniard 西班牙人 ◊ wizard 男巫

-arian.meaning: suffix forming adjectives and nouns meaning ‘(one) concerned with or believing in’ 构成形容词或名词，意为“关于…（的）”或“相信…（的）” ◊ agrarian 有关土地的 ◊ antiquarian 古文物研究者 ◊ humanitarian 人道主义者 ◊ vegetarian 素食者

-arious.meaning: suffix forming adjectives 构成形容词 ◊ gregarious 群居的 ◊ vicarious 代理的

-arium.meaning: suffix forming nouns usu. denoting a place 构成名词，通常表示地点 ◊ aquarium 水族馆 ◊ planetarium 天文馆

-ary.meaning: 1 /əri/ suffix 1. forming adjectives 构成形容词 ◊ budgetary 预算的 ◊ contrary 相反的 ◊ primary 主要的 ◊ unitary 单一的 2. forming nouns 构成名词 ◊ dictionary 字典 ◊ fritillary 贝母属植物 ◊ granary 谷仓 ◊ January 一月 -ary 2 /əri/ suffix forming adjectives 构成形容词 ◊ military 军事的

-ase.meaning: suffix Biochem. forming the name of an enzyme 【生化】 构成酶类名词 ◊ amylase 淀粉酶

-asis.meaning: suffix (usu. as 通常作 -iasis ) forming the names of diseases 构成病名 ◊ psoriasis 牛皮癣 ◊ satyriasis 男子色情狂

-aster.meaning: suffix 1. forming nouns denoting poor quality 构成名词，表示水平低劣的 ◊ criticaster 拙劣批评家 ◊ poetaster 蹩脚诗人，冒牌诗人 2. Bot. denoting incomplete resemblance 【植】 表示不完全相像的 ◊ oleaster 胡颓子属植物 ◊ pinaster 松树类

-ate.meaning: 1 /ət, eit/ suffix 1. forming nouns denoting 构成名词，意为 : a. status or office 地位；职位 ◊ doctorate 博士学位 ◊ episcopate 主教之职 b. state or function 状态；职能 ◊ curate 助理牧师 ◊ magistrate 文职官员 ◊ mandate 命令 2. forming nouns denoting a group 构成名词，表示“一类” ◊ electorate 选民 3. Chem. forming nouns denoting the salt of an acid with a corresponding name ending in -ic 【化】 构成名词，表示酸根名以 -ic 结尾的盐类 ◊ chlorate 氯酸盐 ◊ nitrate 硝酸盐 4. Chem. forming nouns denoting a product 【化】 构成名词，表示某种产出物 ◊ condensate 冷凝物 ◊ filtrate 滤出液 -ate 2 /ət, eit/ suffix 1. forming adjectives and nouns 构成形容词和名词 ◊ associate 副的 ◊ delegate 代表 ◊ duplicate 复制品 ◊ separate 分开的 2. forming adjectives from Latin or English nouns and adjectives 用于某些拉丁或英语名词和形容词，构成形容词 ◊ cordate 心脏性的 ◊ insensate 无感觉的 ◊ Italianate 意大利风格的 -ate 3 /eit/ suffix forming verbs 构成动词 ◊ associate 联系 ◊ duplicate 复制 ◊ fascinate 入迷 ◊ hyphenate 用连字符连接 ◊ separate 分开

-atic.meaning: suffix forming adjectives and nouns 构成形容词和名词 ◊ aquatic 水生的 ◊ fanatic 狂热分子 ◊ idiomatic 具有习语特点的

-ation.meaning: suffix 1. forming nouns denoting an action or an instance of it 构成名词，表示动作或实例 ◊ alteration 更改 ◊ flirtation 调情 ◊ hesitation 犹豫 2. forming nouns denoting a result or product of action 构成名词，表示动作结果 ◊ plantation 种植 ◊ starvation 饥饿 ◊ vexation 恼怒 (see also 另见 -FICATION )

-ative.meaning: suffix forming adjectives denoting a characteristic or propensity 构成形容词，表示特征或倾向 ◊ authoritative 权威的 ◊ imitative 模仿的 ◊ pejorative 退化的 ◊ qualitative 性质上的 ◊ talkative 爱说话的

-ator.meaning: suffix forming agent nouns, usu. from Latin words (sometimes via French) 构成（人、物）名词，通常源于拉丁词（有时源于法语) ◊ agitator 煽动者 ◊ creator 创造者 ◊ equator 赤道 ◊ escalator 电动扶梯 See also 另见 -OR 1

-atory.meaning: suffix forming adjectives meaning ‘relating to or involving (a verbal action)’ 构成形容词，意为“关于”或“涉及”（某一动词动作) ◊ amatory 恋爱的 ◊ explanatory 解释的 ◊ predatory 掠夺的 See also 另见 -ORY 2

-blast.meaning: comb. form Biol. [构词成分] 【生】 1. an embryonic cell 胚细胞，母细胞 ◊ erythroblast 成红细胞 (cf. 参见 -CYTE ) 2. a germ layer of an embryo 表示“胚胎”，“胚层” ◊ epiblast 外胚层

-bodied.meaning: adj. in comb. 用于复合词 : ◊ able-bodied 体格健全的，强壮的 See main entry at body ----> body /ˈbɒdi/ n. & v. n. ( pl. -ies ) 1. the physical structure, including the bones, flesh, and organs, of a person or an animal, whether dead or alive (人或动物的）身体，躯体 2. the trunk apart from the head and the limbs (除头、四肢以外的）躯干，胴体 3. a. the main or central part of a thing （物体的）主干部分 ◊ body of the car 车身 ◊ body of the attack 进攻的主力部队 b. the bulk or majority; the aggregate 主要部分，大部分，大多数 ◊ body of opinion 舆论的主流 4. a. a group of persons regarded collectively, esp. as having a corporate function (尤指有法人作用的）机构，社团，团体 ◊ governing body 执政机构 b. (usu. foll. by 通常后跟 of) a collection (汇集而成的）一群，一批，一组；一堆，（大）量 ◊ body of facts 大量事实 5. a quantity 相当数量 ◊ body of water 水体 6. a material object 物体，天体 ◊ celestial body 天体 7. colloq. a person [口]人 8. a full or substantial quality of flavour, tone, etc., e.g. in wine, musical sounds, etc. (味、声调等的）质地（如酒的醇度、乐声的洪亮圆润等) 9. a bodysuit 紧身衣裤 v. tr. ( -ies , -ied ) (usu. foll. by 通常后跟 forth) give body or substance to 赋…以形体 Phr & Deriv: in a body all together 全体一致地，一块儿 keep body and soul together keep alive, esp. barely 苟且过活（尤指勉强活下去） over my dead body colloq. entirely without my assent [口]除非我死了 -bodied adj. in comb. 用于复合词 : ◊ able-bodied 体格健全的，强壮的

-calved.meaning: adj. (in comb. 用于复合词) See main entry at calf ----> calf 1 /kɑ:f/ n. ( pl. calves /kɑ:vz/) 1. (used esp. of domestic cattle) a young bovine animal (尤指家畜）小牛，牛犊 2. the young of other animals, e.g. elephant, deer, and whale (大象、鹿、鲸鱼等的）仔，幼兽 3. Naut. a floating piece of ice detached from an iceberg 【海】 仔冰，幼冰（脱离冰山的浮冰块） Phr & Deriv: in (or with ) calf (of a cow) pregnant (奶牛）怀了小牛的，怀孕的 calflike adj. calf 2 /kɑ:f/ n. ( pl. calves /kɑ:vz/) the fleshy hind part of the human leg below the knee 腓肠（俗称腿肚） Phr & Deriv: -calved /kɑ:vd/ adj. (in comb. 用于复合词)

-cele.meaning: comb. form (also 亦作 -coele ) Med. swelling, hernia [构词成分] 【医】 肿胀，疝气 ◊ gastrocele 胃膨出

-free.meaning: comb. form free of or from [构词成分]无…的，摆脱了…的；免除…的 ◊ duty-free 免税的 ◊ trouble-free 无忧无虑的

-fuge.meaning: comb. form forming adjectives and nouns denoting expelling or dispelling [构词成分]构成形容词和名词，表示“驱逐”，“逐出” ◊ febrifuge 退热的；退热药 ◊ vermifuge 驱虫的；驱虫药

-ful.meaning: suffix forming 构成 : 1. adjectives from nouns, meaning 形容词（来自名词），表示 : a. full of 充满…的 ◊ beautiful 美丽的 b. having the qualities of 有…性质的 ◊ masterful 专横的 2. adjectives from adjectives or Latin stems with little change of sense 形容词（来自形容词或拉丁语词干，意义几乎无变化) ◊ direful 可怕的 ◊ grateful 感激的 3. adjectives from verbs, meaning ‘apt to’, ‘able to’, ‘accustomed to’ 形容词（来自动词），表示：易于…的，有…倾向的；能…的；习惯（或适应）的 ◊ forgetful 健忘的 ◊ mournful 悲哀的 ◊ useful 有用的 4. nouns ( pl. -fuls ) meaning ‘the amount needed to fill’ 名词，表示“充满…所需要的量” ◊ handful 一把 ◊ spoonful 一匙

-fully.meaning: suffix forming adverbs corresponding to adjectives in -ful 构成与以 -ful 结尾的形容词相对应的副词

-fy.meaning: suffix forming 构成 : 1. verbs from nouns, meaning 动词（来自名词），表示 : a. make, produce 使得；产生 ◊ pacify 使平静 ◊ speechify 高谈阔论 b. make into 使成为；使…化 ◊ deify 神化 ◊ petrify 石化 2. verbs from adjectives, meaning ‘bring or come into such a state’ 动词（来自形容词），表示“（使）变得”，“使…化” ◊ Frenchify (使）法国化 ◊ solidify (使）凝固 3. verbs in causative sense 使役动词 ◊ horrify 使恐怖 ◊ stupefy 使茫然

-gate.meaning: comb. form forming nouns denoting a scandal comparable in some way to the Watergate scandal of 1972 [构词成分]表示类似 1972 年水门事件的丑闻 ◊ Irangate 伊朗门事件

-gen.meaning: comb. form [构词成分] 1. Chem. that which produces 【化】 产生 ◊ hydrogen 氢 ◊ antigen 抗原 2. Bot. growth 【植】 （表示）生长 ◊ endogen 单子叶植物，内生植物 ◊ exogen 外长植物

-genic.meaning: comb. form forming adjectives meaning [构词成分]构成形容词，意为 : 1. producing 生育的，产生的 ◊ carcinogenic 致癌的 ◊ pathogenic 致病的 2. well suited to 合适的，适于…的 ◊ photogenic 适于拍照的 ◊ radiogenic 适合无线电传送的 3. produced by 产生于 ◊ iatrogenic 医原性的 Phr & Deriv: -genically suffix forming adverbs 构成副词

-genically.meaning: suffix forming adverbs 构成副词 See main entry at -genic ----> -genic /ˈdʒenik/ comb. form forming adjectives meaning [构词成分]构成形容词，意为 : 1. producing 生育的，产生的 ◊ carcinogenic 致癌的 ◊ pathogenic 致病的 2. well suited to 合适的，适于…的 ◊ photogenic 适于拍照的 ◊ radiogenic 适合无线电传送的 3. produced by 产生于 ◊ iatrogenic 医原性的 Phr & Deriv: -genically suffix forming adverbs 构成副词

-genous.meaning: comb. form forming adjectives meaning ‘produced’ [构词成分]构成形容词，表示“…生的”，“…发生的”，“…生长的” ◊ endogenous 内生的

-geny.meaning: comb. form forming nouns meaning ‘mode of production or development of’ [构词成分]构成名词表示“产生或发展”的方式 ◊ anthropogeny 人类起源 ◊ ontogeny 个体发生 ◊ pathogeny 病原

-gerous.meaning: comb. form forming adjectives meaning ‘bearing’ [构词成分]构成形容词，表示“有…的”，“生有…的”，“方式”等 ◊ lanigerous 有羊毛的

-gon.meaning: comb. form forming nouns denoting plane figures with a specified number of angles [构词成分]表示“…角形” ◊ hexagon 六边形 ◊ polygon 多边形 ◊ n-gonn N 边形

-gram.meaning: comb. form forming nouns denoting a thing written or recorded (often in a certain way) [构词成分]构成名词，表示（用某种形式）“写的东西”，“记录的东西” ◊ anagram 回文构词法 ◊ epigram 警句 ◊ monogram 花押字 ◊ telegram 电报 Phr & Deriv: -grammatic /ɡrəˈmætik/ comb. form forming adjectives [构词成分]构成形容词

-grammatic.meaning: comb. form forming adjectives [构词成分]构成形容词 See main entry at -gram ----> -gram /ɡræm/ comb. form forming nouns denoting a thing written or recorded (often in a certain way) [构词成分]构成名词，表示（用某种形式）“写的东西”，“记录的东西” ◊ anagram 回文构词法 ◊ epigram 警句 ◊ monogram 花押字 ◊ telegram 电报 Phr & Deriv: -grammatic /ɡrəˈmætik/ comb. form forming adjectives [构词成分]构成形容词

-graph.meaning: comb. form forming nouns and verbs meaning [构词成分]构成名词和动词，表示 : 1. a thing written or drawn etc. in a specified way (以特定方式）写（或画）的东西 ◊ autograph 手稿 ◊ photograph 照片 2. an instrument that records 记录的器具 ◊ heliograph 太阳照相机 ◊ seismograph 地震仪 ◊ telegraph 电报机

-grapher.meaning: comb. form forming nouns denoting a person concerned with a subject etc. with a name ending in -graphy [构词成分]构成名词，表示人名与 -graphy 结尾的学科等有关的人 ◊ geographer 地理学家 ◊ radiographer 拍射线照片的人

-graphic.meaning: comb. form (also 亦作 -graphical ) forming adjectives corresponding to nouns in -graphy [构词成分]构成以 -graphy 结尾的名词相对应的形容词 (see 见 -GRAPHY ) Phr & Deriv: -graphically comb. form forming adverbs [构词成分]构成副词

-graphically.meaning: comb. form forming adverbs [构词成分]构成副词 See main entry at -graphic ----> -graphic /ˈɡræfik/ comb. form (also 亦作 -graphical ) forming adjectives corresponding to nouns in -graphy [构词成分]构成以 -graphy 结尾的名词相对应的形容词 (see 见 -GRAPHY ) Phr & Deriv: -graphically comb. form forming adverbs [构词成分]构成副词

-graphy.meaning: comb. form forming nouns denoting [构词成分]构成名词，表示 : 1. a descriptive science 描叙性学科 ◊ bibliography 文献学 ◊ geography 地理学 2. a technique of producing images 图示法 ◊ photography 照相术 ◊ radiography 射线照相术 3. a style or method of writing, drawing, etc. 写（画等）的方式（方法) ◊ calligraphy 书法

-gynous.meaning: comb. form Bot. forming adjectives meaning ‘having specified female organs or pistils’ [构词成分] 【植】 构成形容词，表示“有特定雌性器官或雌蕊的” ◊ monogynous 单一雌蕊的

-handed.meaning: adj. (in comb. 用于复合词) 1. for or involving a specified number of hands (in various senses) 有…人手的；涉及…手的；由…人做的；由…人玩的 ◊ two-handed 两手的 2. using chiefly the hand specified 用（左或右）手的 ◊ left-handed 使用左手的，左撇子 Phr & Deriv: -handedly adv. -handedness n. (both in sense 2 两者均用于释义 2)

-handedly.meaning: adv. See main entry at -handed ----> -handed /ˈhændid/ adj. (in comb. 用于复合词) 1. for or involving a specified number of hands (in various senses) 有…人手的；涉及…手的；由…人做的；由…人玩的 ◊ two-handed 两手的 2. using chiefly the hand specified 用（左或右）手的 ◊ left-handed 使用左手的，左撇子 Phr & Deriv: -handedly adv. -handedness n. (both in sense 2 两者均用于释义 2)

-handedness.meaning: n. (both in sense 2 两者均用于释义 2) See main entry at -handed ----> -handed /ˈhændid/ adj. (in comb. 用于复合词) 1. for or involving a specified number of hands (in various senses) 有…人手的；涉及…手的；由…人做的；由…人玩的 ◊ two-handed 两手的 2. using chiefly the hand specified 用（左或右）手的 ◊ left-handed 使用左手的，左撇子 Phr & Deriv: -handedly adv. -handedness n. (both in sense 2 两者均用于释义 2)

-head.meaning: suffix = -HOOD ◊ godhead 神性 ◊ maidenhead 处女性；处女时期

-hedral.meaning: comb. form forming adjectives [构词成分]构成形容词 See main entry at -hedron ----> -hedron /ˈhi:drən, ˈhed-/ comb. form ( pl. -hedra or -hedrons ) forming nouns denoting geometrical solids with various numbers or shapes of faces [构词成分]…面体 ◊ dodecahedron 十二面体 ◊ rhombohedron 菱面体 Phr & Deriv: -hedral comb. form forming adjectives [构词成分]构成形容词

-hedron.meaning: comb. form ( pl. -hedra or -hedrons ) forming nouns denoting geometrical solids with various numbers or shapes of faces [构词成分]…面体 ◊ dodecahedron 十二面体 ◊ rhombohedron 菱面体 Phr & Deriv: -hedral comb. form forming adjectives [构词成分]构成形容词

-hood.meaning: suffix forming nouns 构成名词 : 1. of condition or state 表示“状况”，“状态” ◊ childhood 儿童时期 ◊ falsehood 错误 2. indicating a collection or group 表示“集体”，“团体” ◊ sisterhood 姐妹关系 ◊ neighbourhood 邻里关系

-hued.meaning: adj. See main entry at hue ----> hue /hju:/ n. 1. a. a colour or tint 颜色；色彩 b. a variety or shade of colour caused by the admixture of another 色泽；色度 2. the attribute of a colour by virtue of which it is discernible as red, green, etc. 色调 Phr & Deriv: -hued adj. hueless adj.

-humoured.meaning: adj. (in comb. 用于复合词) See main entry at humour ----> humour /ˈhju:mə/ n. & v. (US [美] humor ) n. 1. a. the quality of being amusing or comic 幽默；诙谐；滑稽 b. the expression of humour in literature, speech, etc. (文学、讲演等中的）幽默表达 2. (in full 全称 sense of humour ) the ability to perceive or express humour or take a joke 幽默感 3. a mood or state of mind 心情，心境；情绪；性情 ◊ bad humour 心情不佳 4. an inclination or whim 倾向；古怪念头 ◊ in the humour for fighting 想打架 5. (in full 全称 cardinal humour ) hist. each of the four chief fluids of the body (blood, phlegm, yellow bile, black bile), thought to determine a person's physical and mental qualities [史义]体液（人体内有 4 种体液：血液、黏汁、黄胆汁和黑胆汁，被认为决定人的身心状况) v. tr. 1. gratify or indulge (a person or taste etc.) 迎合；纵容 2. adapt oneself to; make concessions to 使自己适应；向…让步 Phr & Deriv: out of humour displeased 生气，心情不好 -humoured adj. (in comb. 用于复合词) humourless adj. humourlessly adv. humourlessness n.

-i.meaning: 1 /i, ai, i:/ suffix forming the plural of nouns from Latin ending in -us or from Italian ending in -e or -o 构成以 -us 结尾的拉丁语名词的复数及以 -e 或 -o 结尾的意大利语名词的复数 ◊ foci 焦点 ◊ dilettanti 艺术爱好者 ◊ timpani 定音鼓 -i 2 suffix forming adjectives from names of countries or regions in the Near or Middle East 构成近东、中东一带国名、地区名的形容词 ◊ Israeli 以色列的 ◊ Pakistani 巴基斯坦的

-i-.meaning: a connecting vowel esp. forming words ending in -ana, -ferous, -fic, -form, -fy, -gerous, -vorous 连接元音（尤构成以 -ana 、 -ferous 、 -fic 、 -form 、 -fy 、 -gerous 和 -vorous 结尾的词) (cf. 参见 -O- )

-ia.meaning: 1 /iə/ suffix 1. forming abstract nouns 构成抽象名词 ◊ mania 躁狂 ◊ utopia 理想国 , often in Med. ( 常用于） 【医】 ◊ anaemia 贫血症 ◊ pneumonia 肺炎 2. Bot. forming names of classes and genera 【植】 构成纲、属的名称 ◊ dahlia 大丽花属植物 ◊ fuchsia 倒挂金钟属植物 3. forming names of countries 构成国家名称 ◊ Australia 澳大利亚 ◊ India 印度 -ia 2 /iə/ suffix forming plural nouns or the plural of nouns 构成复数名词或名词的复数 : 1. from Greek ending -ion or Latin -ium 源自希腊语结尾的 -ion 或拉丁语结尾的 -ium ◊ paraphernalia 随身物品 ◊ regalia 王权 ◊ amnia 羊膜 ◊ labia 阴唇 2. Zool. the names of groups 【动】 群、类的纲目 ◊ Mammalia 哺乳纲

-ial.meaning: suffix forming adjectives 构成形容词 ◊ celestial 天空的 ◊ dictatorial 独裁的 ◊ trivial 琐细的

-iasis.meaning: suffix the usual form of -ASIS -ASIS 的通常形式

-ibility.meaning: suffix forming nouns from, or corresponding to, adjectives in -ible 构成以 -ible 结尾的形容词的名词及与以 -ible 结尾的形容词相对应的名词 ◊ possibility 可能性 ◊ credibility 可信性

-ible.meaning: suffix forming adjectives meaning ‘that may or may be’ 构成形容词，表示“可（被）…的”，“能…的” ◊ terrible 可怕的 ◊ forcible 强迫的 ◊ possible 可能的 (see 见 -ABLE )

-ibly.meaning: suffix forming adverbs corresponding to adjectives in -ible 构成与以 -ible 结尾的形容词相对应的副词

-ic.meaning: suffix 1. forming adjectives 构成形容词 ◊ Arabic 阿拉伯的 ◊ classic 古典的 ◊ public 公众的 and nouns 和名词 ◊ critic 批评家 ◊ epic 史诗 ◊ mechanic 技工 ◊ music 音乐 2. Chem. in higher valence or degree of oxidation 【化】 原子价较高的；氧化程度较高的 ◊ ferric 三价铁的 ◊ sulphuric 硫的 (see also 另见 -OUS ) 3. denoting a particular form or instance of a noun in -ics 表示以 -ics 结尾的名词形式（或实例) ◊ aesthetic 美学 ◊ tactic 战术

-ical.meaning: suffix 1. forming adjectives corresponding to nouns or adjectives, usu. ending in -ic 构成常以 -ic 结尾的名词相应的形容词 ◊ classical 第一流的 ◊ comical 好笑的 ◊ farcical 笑剧的 ◊ musical 音乐的 2. forming adjectives corresponding to nouns in -y 构成与以 -y 结尾的名词相关的形容词 ◊ pathological 病理学的

-ically.meaning: suffix forming adverbs corresponding to adjectives ending in -ic or -ical 构成与以 -ic 或 -ical 结尾的形容词相关的副词 ◊ comically 好笑地 ◊ musically 悦耳地 ◊ tragically 悲惨地

-ice.meaning: suffix forming (esp. abstract) nouns 构成（尤指抽象）名词 ◊ avarice 贪婪 ◊ justice 正义 ◊ service 服务 (cf. 参见 -ESS 2 , -ISE 2 )

-ician.meaning: suffix forming nouns denoting persons skilled in or concerned with subjects having nouns (usu.) in -ic or -ics 构成名词，表示“精通者”及名词以 -ic 和 -ics 结尾的某领域内的“专家”，“能手” ◊ magician 魔术师 ◊ politician 政治家

-icity.meaning: suffix forming abstract nouns esp. from adjectives in -ic 构成抽象名词（尤源自以 -ic 结尾的形容词) ◊ authenticity 可靠性 ◊ publicity 公开性

-ick.meaning: suffix archaic var. of -IC [古义] -IC 的变体

-icle.meaning: suffix forming (originally diminutive) nouns 构成（源于指小词的）名词 ◊ article 冠词 ◊ particle 微粒；粒子

-ics.meaning: suffix (treated as sing. or pl. 看作单数或复数) forming nouns denoting arts or sciences or branches of study or action 构成名词，表示人文科学（自然科学、研究学科）领域（或活动) ◊ athletics 竞技 ◊ politics 政治学 (cf. 参见 -IC 3)

-id.meaning: 1 /id/ suffix forming adjectives 构成形容词 ◊ arid 干旱的 ◊ rapid 迅速的 -id 2 /id/ suffix forming nouns 构成名词 : 1. general 一般事物 ◊ pyramid 金字塔 2. Biol. of structural constituents 【生】 （表示）结构要素 ◊ plastid 质体 3. Bot. of a plant belonging to a family with a name in -idaceae 【植】 （表示）以 -idaceae 结尾的…科植物 ◊ orchid 兰花 -id 3 /id/ suffix forming nouns denoting 构成名词，表示 : 1. Zool. an animal belonging to a family with a name in -idae or a class with a name in -ida 【动】 以 -idae 结尾或以 -ida 结尾的…纲动物 ◊ canid 犬科动物 ◊ arachnid 蛛形纲动物 2. a member of a person's family …家族的成员 ◊ Seleucid from Seleucus 塞琉古家族成员塞琉西 3. Astron. 【天】 a. a meteor in a group radiating from a specified constellation 由某一星座散发出的流星 ◊ Leonid from Leo 狮子星座散发出的狮子座流星 b. a star of a class like one in a specified constellation 某一类型的变星 ◊ cepheid 造父变星

-ide.meaning: suffix Chem. forming nouns denoting 【化】 构成名词，表示 : 1. binary compounds of an element (the suffix -ide being added to the abbreviated name of the more electronegative element etc.) (后缀 -ide 加在电负性元素等的缩略名称后）二元化合物 ◊ sodium chloride 氯化钠 ◊ lead sulphide 硫化铅 ◊ calcium carbide 碳化钙 2. various other compounds （各种其他的）化合物 ◊ amide 酰胺 ◊ anhydride 硬石膏 ◊ peptide 肽 ◊ saccharide 糖化物 3. elements of a series in the periodic table （元素周期表里的）一系列元素 ◊ actinide 锕类 ◊ lanthanide 镧系元素

-ie.meaning: suffix 1. var. of -Y 2 -Y 2 的变体 ◊ dearie 亲爱的 ◊ nightie 睡衣 2. archaic var. of -Y 1 , -Y 3 ◊ litanie 祷文 ◊ prettie 宝贝儿 [古义] -Y 1 ， -Y 3 的变体

-ier.meaning: suffix forming personal nouns denoting an occupation or interest 构成人称名词，表示与职业（兴趣）有关的人 : 1. with stress on the preceding element 重音在前面成分 ◊ grazier 养畜者 2. with stress on the suffix 重音在后缀上 ◊ cashier 出纳员 ◊ brigadier 旅长

-il.meaning: suffix (also 亦作 -ile /ail/) forming adjectives or nouns denoting relation 构成形容词和名词，表示关系 ◊ civil 民用的 ◊ utensil 器皿 or capability 及能力 ◊ agile 敏捷的 ◊ sessile 无柄的

-ily.meaning: suffix forming adverbs corresponding to adjectives in -y (see 见 -Y 1 , -LY 2 ) 构成与以 y 结尾的形容词相关的副词

-in.meaning: suffix Chem. forming names of organic compounds, pharmaceutical products, proteins, etc. 【化】 构成有机化合物、药品、蛋白质等的名称 ◊ dioxin 二氧（杂）芑 ◊ fibrin 血纤蛋白 ◊ gelatin 明胶 ◊ penicillin 青霉素

-in-chief.meaning: comb. form (as second element) supreme [构词成分] (作为第二个构成部分）最高的，至上的 ◊ commander-in-chief 最高统帅；总司令

-ina.meaning: suffix denoting 表示 : 1. feminine names and titles 女性名字及称谓 ◊ Georgina 乔治娜 ◊ tsarina 沙皇皇后 2. names of musical instruments 乐器名称 ◊ concertina 六角形手风琴 3. names of zoological classification categories 动物分类类别名称 ◊ globigerina 抱球虫亚目

-incomer.meaning: comb. form Brit. earning a specified kind or level of income [构词成分] [英]赚取特定种类（或水平）的收入者 ◊ middle-incomer 中等收入者

-ine.meaning: 1 /ain, in, i:n/ suffix forming adjectives, meaning ‘belonging to, of the nature of’ 构成形容词，表示“属于…的”，“具有…属性” ◊ Alpine 具有阿尔卑斯人特征的 ◊ asinine (像驴一样）笨的 -ine 2 /ain/ suffix forming adjectives esp. from names of minerals, plants, etc. (尤指）构成相应于矿物、植物等名词的形容词 ◊ crystalline 结晶的 -ine 3 /in, i:n/ suffix forming feminine nouns 构成阴性名词 ◊ heroine 女英雄 ◊ margravine 侯爵夫人 -ine 4 suffix 1. /in/ forming (esp. abstract) nouns 构成名词（尤指抽象名词) ◊ discipline 纪律 ◊ medicine 医学 2. /i:n, in/ Chem. forming nouns denoting derived substances, esp. alkaloids, halogens, amines, and amino acids 【化】 构成衍生物的名词，尤指生物碱、卤素、胺及氨基酸

-iness.meaning: suffix forming nouns corresponding to adjectives ending in -y 构成以 -y 结尾的形容词的相应名词 (see 见 -Y 1 , -LY 2 )

-ing.meaning: 1 /iŋ/ suffix forming gerunds and nouns from verbs (or occasionally from nouns), denoting 由动词（偶然由名词）构成动名词或名词，表示 : 1. a. the verbal action or its result 动作或动作的结果 ◊ asking 询问 ◊ carving 雕刻 ◊ fighting 斗争 ◊ learning 学习 b. the verbal action as described or classified in some way 按某种方式对动词行为进行描述或分类 ◊ tough going 艰难的进程 2. material used for or associated with a process etc. 用于制作某物的材料 ◊ piping 管材 ◊ washing 洗涤剂 3. an occupation or event 职业，事件 ◊ banking 银行业 ◊ wedding 结婚庆典 4. a set or arrangement of 一组，一套；一种安排 ◊ colouring 着色 ◊ feathering 絮羽 -ing 2 /iŋ/ suffix 1. forming the present participle of verbs 构成动词的现在分词 ◊ asking 询问 ◊ fighting 斗争 , often as adjectives 常作形容词 ◊ charming 媚人的 ◊ strapping 强壮的 2. forming adjectives from nouns 由名词构成形容词 ◊ hulking 庞大的 -ing 3 /iŋ/ suffix forming nouns meaning ‘one belonging to’ or ‘one having the quality of’, surviving esp. in names of coins and fractional parts 构成名词，表示“属于这一类的一个”，“具有此性质的一个”，尤见于硬币名称 ◊ farthing 1/4 旧便士（的硬币） ◊ gelding 骟马 ◊ riding 乘骑

-ingly.meaning: suffix forming adverbs esp. denoting manner of action or nature or condition 构成副词，尤表示行为方式、性质或状况“…地” ◊ dotingly 溺爱地 ◊ charmingly 媚人地 ◊ slantingly 倾斜地

-ion.meaning: suffix (usu. as 通常作 -sion , -tion , -xion ; see 见 -ATION , -ITION , -UTION ) forming nouns denoting 构成名词，表示 : 1. verbal action 动词行为 ◊ excision 删除；切除 2. an instance of this 动词行为的实例 ◊ a suggestion 一项建议 3. a resulting state or product 状态；结果 ◊ vexation 烦恼 ◊ concoction 阴谋

-ior.meaning: 1 /iə, jə/ suffix forming adjectives of comparison 构成形容词的比较级 ◊ senior 较年长的 ◊ ulterior 较远的 -ior 2 var. of -IOUR -IOUR 的变体

-iour.meaning: suffix (also 亦作 -ior ) forming nouns 构成名词 ◊ saviour 救星 ◊ warrior 武士

-ious.meaning: suffix forming adjectives meaning ‘characterized by, full of’, often corresponding to nouns in -ion 构成形容词，表示“具有…性质的”；“充满…的”（常与带 -ion 的名词相对应) ◊ cautious 谨慎的 ◊ curious 好奇的 ◊ spacious 广阔的

-ique.meaning: archaic var. of -IC [古义] -IC 的变体

-ise.meaning: 1 suffix var. of -IZE -IZE 的变体 -ise 2 /aiz, i:z/ suffix forming nouns of quality, state, or function 构成性质、状态、功能的名词 ◊ exercise 练习 ◊ expertise 专长 ◊ franchise 特权 ◊ merchandise 商品 -ise 3 suffix var. of -ISH 2 -ISH 2 的变体

-ish.meaning: 1 /iʃ/ suffix forming adjectives 构成形容词 : 1. from nouns, meaning 由名词演变，表示 : a. having the qualities or characteristics of 有…性质的；有…特征的 ◊ boyish 孩子气的 b. of the nationality of …民族的 ◊ Danish 丹麦人的 2. from adjectives, meaning ‘somewhat’ 由形容词演变，表示“有点儿…的” ◊ thickish 有些厚的 3. colloq. denoting an approximate age or time of day [口] (表示年龄或时间）大约…，…左右 ◊ fortyish 40 岁上下 ◊ six-thirtyish 6 点 30 分左右 -ish 2 /iʃ/ suffix (also 亦作 -ise /aiz/) forming verbs 构成动词 ◊ vanish 消失

-ism.meaning: suffix forming nouns, esp. denoting 构成名词，尤表示 : 1. an action or its result 行动；结果 ◊ baptism 洗礼 ◊ organism 有机体 2. a system, principle, or ideological movement 制度；学说；思想运动 ◊ Conservatism 保守主义 ◊ jingoism 侵略主义 ◊ feminism 争取女权运动 3. a state or quality 状态；特性 ◊ heroism 英雄主义 ◊ barbarism 野蛮状态 4. a basis of prejudice or discrimination 偏见；歧视 ◊ racism 种族主义 ◊ sexism 性别歧视 5. a peculiarity in language 语言的特色 ◊ Americanism 美国用语 6. a pathological condition 病态 ◊ alcoholism 酒精中毒 ◊ Parkinsonism 震颤（性）麻痹帕金森氏症

-ison.meaning: suffix forming nouns 构成名词， ◊ comparison 对照 ◊ garrison 驻军 ◊ jettison 投弃 ◊ venison 野味 = -ATION

-ist.meaning: suffix forming personal nouns (and in some senses related adjectives) denoting 构成人称名词（在有些释义中构成形容词），表示 : 1. an adherent of a system etc. in -ism 以 -ism 结尾的某制度等的追随者，信仰者 ◊ Marxist 马克思主义者 ◊ fatalist 宿命论者 (see 见 -ISM 2) 2. a. a member of a profession 专业人员 ◊ pathologist 病理学家 b. a person concerned with something 从事…的人 ◊ tobacconist 烟草商 3. a person who uses a thing 某物使用者 ◊ violinist 小提琴手 ◊ balloonist 乘气球升空者 ◊ motorist 开汽车的人 4. a person who does something expressed by a verb in -ize 用以 -ize 结尾的动词表示做某事的人 ◊ plagiarist 剽窃者 5. a person who subscribes to a prejudice or practises discrimination 赞成偏见或实行歧视的人 ◊ racist 种族主义分子 ◊ sexist 主张性别歧视者

-ite.meaning: 1 /ait/ suffix forming nouns meaning ‘a person or thing connected with’ 构成名词，表示“有关联的人或物” : 1. in names of persons 人的名称 : a. as natives of a country 某国的居民 ◊ Israelite 以色列人 b. often derog. as followers of a movement etc. [常贬]…运动等的追随者 ◊ pre-Raphaelite 拉斐尔之前的意大利画家 ◊ Trotskyite 托洛茨基分子 2. in names of things 事物名称 : a. fossil organisms 化石生物体 ◊ ammonite 菊石 b. minerals 矿石 ◊ graphite 石墨 c. constituent parts of a body or organ 身体的组成部分或器官 ◊ somite 体节 d. explosives 爆炸物 ◊ dynamite 达纳炸药 e. commercial products 商品 ◊ ebonite 硬橡胶 ◊ vulcanite 硬质橡胶 f. salts of acids having names in -ous 带 -ous 的酸盐类 ◊ nitrite 亚硝酸盐 ◊ sulphite 亚硫酸盐 -ite 2 /ait, it/ suffix 1. forming adjectives 构成形容词 ◊ erudite 博学的 ◊ favourite 特别受喜爱的 2. forming nouns 构成名词 ◊ appetite 胃口 3. forming verbs 构成动词 ◊ expedite 加速执行 ◊ unite 团结

-itic.meaning: suffix forming adjectives and nouns corresponding to nouns in -ite, -itis, etc. 构成形容词或名词，与以 -ite, -itis 等结尾的名词相对应 ◊ Semitic 闪语族的 ◊ arthritic 关节炎的 ◊ syphilitic 梅毒的

-ition.meaning: suffix forming nouns 构成名词 ◊ admonition 告诫 ◊ perdition 毁灭 ◊ position 位置 = -ATION

-itious.meaning: 1 /ˈiʃəs/ suffix forming adjectives corresponding to nouns in -ition 构成形容词，与以 -ition 结尾的名词相对应 ◊ ambitious 有雄心的 ◊ suppositious 假设的；冒充的 -itious 2 /ˈiʃəs/ suffix forming adjectives meaning ‘related to, having the nature of’ 构成形容词，表示“与…有关的”，“有…特性的” ◊ adventitious 偶然的 ◊ supposititious 冒充的

-itis.meaning: suffix forming nouns, esp. 构成名词，（尤指): 1. names of inflammatory diseases 炎症名称 ◊ appendicitis 阑尾炎 ◊ bronchitis 支气管炎 2. colloq. in extended uses with reference to conditions compared to diseases [口]…癖 ◊ electionitis 竞选癖

-itive.meaning: suffix forming adjectives 构成形容词 ◊ positive 肯定的 ◊ transitive 及物的 = -ATIVE

-itor.meaning: suffix forming agent nouns, usu. from Latin words (sometimes via French) (常从拉丁文，有时通过法语）构成施动者名词 ◊ creditor 债权人 See also 另见 -OR 1

-itory.meaning: suffix forming adjectives meaning ‘relating to or involving (a verbal action)’ 构成形容词，表示与…（动词动作）有关的 ◊ inhibitory 禁止的 See also 另见 -ORY 2

-itous.meaning: suffix forming adjectives corresponding to nouns in -ity 构成形容词，与以 -ty 结尾的名词相对应 ◊ calamitous 灾难的 ◊ felicitous 恰当的

-ity.meaning: suffix forming nouns denoting 构成名词，表示 : 1. quality or condition 特性；状态 ◊ authority 权力 ◊ humility 谦卑 ◊ purity 纯净 2. an instance or degree of this 事例；程度 ◊ a monstrosity 怪异性 ◊ capacity 容量

-ium.meaning: suffix forming nouns denoting esp. 构成名词，尤表示 : 1. (also 亦作 -um ) names of metallic elements 金属元素名称 ◊ uranium 铀 ◊ tantalum 钽 2. a region of the body 身体部位 ◊ pericardium 心包 ◊ hypogastrium 下腹 3. a biological structure 生物结构 ◊ mycelium 菌丝体 ◊ prothallium 原叶体

-ive.meaning: suffix forming adjectives meaning ‘tending to, having the nature of’, and corresponding nouns 构成形容词，表示“有…倾向的，有…特性的”，与名词相对应 ◊ suggestive 示意的 ◊ corrosive 腐蚀的 ◊ palliative 缓和的 ◊ coercive 强迫的 ◊ talkative 健谈的 Phr & Deriv: -ively suffix forming adverbs 构成副词 -iveness suffix forming nouns 构成名词

-ively.meaning: suffix forming adverbs 构成副词 See main entry at -ive ----> -ive /iv/ suffix forming adjectives meaning ‘tending to, having the nature of’, and corresponding nouns 构成形容词，表示“有…倾向的，有…特性的”，与名词相对应 ◊ suggestive 示意的 ◊ corrosive 腐蚀的 ◊ palliative 缓和的 ◊ coercive 强迫的 ◊ talkative 健谈的 Phr & Deriv: -ively suffix forming adverbs 构成副词 -iveness suffix forming nouns 构成名词

-iveness.meaning: suffix forming nouns 构成名词 See main entry at -ive ----> -ive /iv/ suffix forming adjectives meaning ‘tending to, having the nature of’, and corresponding nouns 构成形容词，表示“有…倾向的，有…特性的”，与名词相对应 ◊ suggestive 示意的 ◊ corrosive 腐蚀的 ◊ palliative 缓和的 ◊ coercive 强迫的 ◊ talkative 健谈的 Phr & Deriv: -ively suffix forming adverbs 构成副词 -iveness suffix forming nouns 构成名词

-ization.meaning: suffix forming nouns 构成名词 See main entry at -ize ----> -ize /aiz/ suffix (also 亦作 -ise ) forming verbs, meaning 构成动词，表示 : 1. make or become such 使成为；使形成 ◊ Americanize 美国化 ◊ pulverize 使成粉末 ◊ realize 实现 2. treat in such a way 照这种方法处理 ◊ monopolize 垄断 ◊ pasteurize 用巴氏法消毒 3. a. follow a special practice 按某种方法 ◊ economize 节约 b. have a specified feeling 有一定的感情 ◊ sympathize 同情 4. affect with, provide with, or subject to 打动；提供；使易受 ◊ oxidize 使氧化 ◊ hospitalize 住院治疗 Phr & Deriv: -ization /-ˈzeiʃ(ə)n/ suffix forming nouns 构成名词 -izer suffix forming agent nouns 构成动原名词

-ize.meaning: suffix (also 亦作 -ise ) forming verbs, meaning 构成动词，表示 : 1. make or become such 使成为；使形成 ◊ Americanize 美国化 ◊ pulverize 使成粉末 ◊ realize 实现 2. treat in such a way 照这种方法处理 ◊ monopolize 垄断 ◊ pasteurize 用巴氏法消毒 3. a. follow a special practice 按某种方法 ◊ economize 节约 b. have a specified feeling 有一定的感情 ◊ sympathize 同情 4. affect with, provide with, or subject to 打动；提供；使易受 ◊ oxidize 使氧化 ◊ hospitalize 住院治疗 Phr & Deriv: -ization /-ˈzeiʃ(ə)n/ suffix forming nouns 构成名词 -izer suffix forming agent nouns 构成动原名词

-izer.meaning: suffix forming agent nouns 构成动原名词 See main entry at -ize ----> -ize /aiz/ suffix (also 亦作 -ise ) forming verbs, meaning 构成动词，表示 : 1. make or become such 使成为；使形成 ◊ Americanize 美国化 ◊ pulverize 使成粉末 ◊ realize 实现 2. treat in such a way 照这种方法处理 ◊ monopolize 垄断 ◊ pasteurize 用巴氏法消毒 3. a. follow a special practice 按某种方法 ◊ economize 节约 b. have a specified feeling 有一定的感情 ◊ sympathize 同情 4. affect with, provide with, or subject to 打动；提供；使易受 ◊ oxidize 使氧化 ◊ hospitalize 住院治疗 Phr & Deriv: -ization /-ˈzeiʃ(ə)n/ suffix forming nouns 构成名词 -izer suffix forming agent nouns 构成动原名词

-jowled.meaning: adj. (in comb. 用于复合词) See main entry at jowl ----> jowl 1 /dʒaʊl/ n. 1. the jaw or jawbone 颌；颌骨 2. the cheek 面颊 ◊ cheek by jowl 紧靠着，非常亲密 Phr & Deriv: -jowled adj. (in comb. 用于复合词) jowl 2 /dʒaʊl/ n. 1. the external loose skin on the throat or neck when prominent 下颌垂肉，双下巴 2. the dewlap of an ox, wattle of a bird, etc. (牛的）颈垂肉；（禽鸟等的）肉垂 Phr & Deriv: jowly adj.

-kin.meaning: suffix forming diminutive nouns 构成表示“小”的名词 ◊ catkin 柔荑花 ◊ manikin 侏儒

-kins.meaning: suffix = -KIN , often with suggestions of endearment 常带可爱之意 ◊ babykins 小宝贝

-later.meaning: comb. form [构词成分] denoting a person who worships a particular thing or person 表示“崇拜者” ◊ idolater 偶像崇拜者

-latry.meaning: comb. form denoting worship [构词成分]表示“崇拜” ◊ idolatry 对偶像的崇拜

-le.meaning: 1 /(ə)l/ suffix forming nouns, esp. 构成名词，尤指 : 1. names of appliances or instruments 工具（或器具）的名称 ◊ handle 手柄 ◊ thimble 顶针箍 2. names of animals and plants 动物（或植物）名称 ◊ beetle 甲虫 ◊ thistle 蓟 -le 2 /(ə)l/ suffix (also 亦作 -el ) forming nouns with (or originally with) diminutive sense 构成名词，表示小（或原本有小）的意思 ◊ angle 角 ◊ castle 城堡 ◊ mantle 披风 ◊ syllable 音节 ◊ novel 小说 ◊ tunnel 隧道 -le 3 /(ə)l/ suffix forming adjectives, often with (or originally with) the sense ‘apt or liable to’ 构成形容词，常带有（或原本带有）“易于”，“倾向于” ◊ brittle 易碎的 ◊ fickle 易变的 ◊ little 小的 ◊ nimble 灵活的 -le 4 /(ə)l/ suffix forming verbs, esp. expressing repeated action or movement or having diminutive sense 构成动词，尤表示“重复”或“小幅度重复” ◊ bubble 冒泡 ◊ crumple 使皱 ◊ wriggle 蠕动

-lent.meaning: suffix forming adjectives 构成形容词 ◊ pestilent 致命的 ◊ violent 暴力的 (cf. 参见 -ULENT )

-less.meaning: suffix forming adjectives and adverbs 构成形容词和副词 : 1. from nouns, meaning ‘not having, without, free from’ 由名词变化而来，表示“没有”，“无”，“不” ◊ doubtless 不怀疑的 ◊ powerless 无权的 2. from verbs, meaning ‘not affected by or doing the action of the verb’ 由动词变化而来，表示“不”，“无”，“没有”（不受动词动作的影响或不做此动作) ◊ fathomless 深不可测的；无法理解的 ◊ tireless 不知疲劳的 Phr & Deriv: -lessly suffix forming adverbs 构成副词 -lessness suffix forming nouns 构成名词

-lessly.meaning: suffix forming adverbs 构成副词 See main entry at -less ----> -less /lis/ suffix forming adjectives and adverbs 构成形容词和副词 : 1. from nouns, meaning ‘not having, without, free from’ 由名词变化而来，表示“没有”，“无”，“不” ◊ doubtless 不怀疑的 ◊ powerless 无权的 2. from verbs, meaning ‘not affected by or doing the action of the verb’ 由动词变化而来，表示“不”，“无”，“没有”（不受动词动作的影响或不做此动作) ◊ fathomless 深不可测的；无法理解的 ◊ tireless 不知疲劳的 Phr & Deriv: -lessly suffix forming adverbs 构成副词 -lessness suffix forming nouns 构成名词

-lessness.meaning: suffix forming nouns 构成名词 See main entry at -less ----> -less /lis/ suffix forming adjectives and adverbs 构成形容词和副词 : 1. from nouns, meaning ‘not having, without, free from’ 由名词变化而来，表示“没有”，“无”，“不” ◊ doubtless 不怀疑的 ◊ powerless 无权的 2. from verbs, meaning ‘not affected by or doing the action of the verb’ 由动词变化而来，表示“不”，“无”，“没有”（不受动词动作的影响或不做此动作) ◊ fathomless 深不可测的；无法理解的 ◊ tireless 不知疲劳的 Phr & Deriv: -lessly suffix forming adverbs 构成副词 -lessness suffix forming nouns 构成名词

-let.meaning: suffix forming nouns, usu. diminutives 构成名词，通常表示小的东西 ◊ flatlet 小套间 ◊ leaflet 小叶 or denoting articles of ornament or dress 表示小装饰或衣物 ◊ anklet 脚镯

-like.meaning: comb. form forming adjectives from nouns, meaning ‘similar to, characteristic of’ comb.form [构词成分] (与名词一起构成形容词）像…似的；具有…特点的 ◊ doglike 像狗似的 ◊ shell-like 像贝壳似的 ◊ tortoise-like 像乌龟似的

-liner.meaning: comb. form (prec. by a numeral 前接数字 , usu. 通常为 one or two) colloq. a spoken passage of a specified number of lines in a play etc. [构词成分] [口] (剧本等的）台词 ◊ a one-liner 一行的台词

-ling.meaning: 1 /liŋ/ suffix 1. denoting a person or thing 表示人（或物): a. connected with 与…相关的人（或物) ◊ hireling 雇佣工 ◊ sapling 树苗 b. having the property of being 有…性质的 ◊ weakling 虚弱的人 ◊ underling 下属 or undergoing 有承受特性的 ◊ starveling 挨饿者 2. denoting a diminutive 表示小的 ◊ duckling 小鸭 , often derogatory 常带贬义 ◊ lordling 小贵族 -ling 2 /liŋ/ suffix forming adverbs and adjectives 构成副词或形容词 ◊ darkling 在黑暗中，在黑暗中的 (cf. 参见 -LONG )

-lite.meaning: suffix forming names of minerals and fossils 构成“矿石”和“化石”类的名称 ◊ rhyolite 流纹岩 ◊ zeolite 沸石

-lith.meaning: suffix denoting types of stone 表明“石”的类型 ◊ laccolith 岩盖 ◊ monolith 磐石

-loading.meaning: adj. (in comb. 用于复合词) (in sense 2 用于释义 2) See main entry at loader ----> loader /ˈləʊdə/ n. 1. a loading machine 装卸设备；装弹机 2. (in comb. 用于复合词) a gun, machine, lorry, etc., loaded in a specified way 按照某种特殊方法装填的枪炮（机器、卡车等) ◊ breech-loader 后装式机械 3. an attendant who loads guns at a shoot 装弹手 Phr & Deriv: -loading adj. (in comb. 用于复合词) (in sense 2 用于释义 2)

-locked.meaning: adj. (in comb. 用于复合词) See main entry at lock ----> lock 1 /lɒk/ n. & v. n. 1. a mechanism for fastening a door, lid, etc., with a bolt that requires a key of a particular shape, or a combination of movements (see COMBINATION LOCK ), to work it 锁（闩住门、盖子等的机械装置，需用钥匙或动作组合开启) 2. a confined section of a canal or river where the level can be changed for raising and lowering boats between adjacent sections by the use of gates and sluices （运河或河流等的）船闸 3. a. the turning of the front wheels of a vehicle to change its direction of motion （车辆）前轮转向角 b. (in full 全称 full lock ) the maximum extent of this 前轮最大转向角 4. an interlocked or jammed state 锁住；阻塞 5. Wrestling a hold that prevents an opponent from moving a limb 【摔跤】 抱紧对手的手脚（使不能动弹） 6. (in full 全称 lock forward ) Rugby a player in the second row of a scrum 【英式橄榄球】 （争球阵营的）第二排球员 7. an appliance to keep a wheel from revolving or slewing 制动器 8. a mechanism for exploding the charge of a gun 枪机 9. = AIRLOCK 2 v. 1. a. tr. fasten with a lock 用锁锁住 b. tr. (foll. by 后跟 up) shut and secure (esp. a building) by locking 关上并锁住（尤指建筑物） c. intr. (of a door, window, box, etc.) have the means of being locked (指门、窗、箱子等）有锁的；可锁上的 2. tr. a. (foll. by 后跟 up, in, into) enclose (a person or thing) by locking or as if by locking 把（人或物）锁藏起来 b. (foll. by 后跟 up) colloq. imprison (a person) [口]把（人）关押起来 3. tr. (absol. -paced.meaning: adj. (of a horse) (马) = AMBLE 2. tr. traverse by pacing 步越 3. tr. set the pace for (a rider, runner, etc.) 为（骑马者或赛跑者等）定步速（或速度） 4. tr. (often foll. by 常后跟 out) measure (a distance) by pacing 步测（一段距离） Phr & Deriv: keep pace (often foll. by 常后跟 with) advance at an equal rate (as) (与…）齐步前进 put a person through his (or her ) paces test a person's qualities in action etc. （在行动等中）测试一个人的品质 set the pace determine the speed, esp. by leading 定速度（尤指起带头作用） stand (or stay ) the pace be able to keep up with others 能跟上他人，能和他人保持一致 -paced adj. pacer n. pace 2 /ˈpɑ:tʃei, ˈpeisi/ prep. [英] a. a tax levied by local authorities on commercial properties (and, until recently, dwellings) at so much per pound of the assessed value of buildings and land owned or leased (now replaced by the council tax for dwellings) (地方政府征收的）不动产税（率）；地方税 b. atomic physics.meaning: n. the branch of physics concerned with the structure of the atom and the characteristics of the subatomic particles 原子物理学

atomic power.meaning: n. nuclear power 原子动力，核动力

atomic spectrum.meaning: n. the emission or absorption spectrum arising from electron transitions inside an atom and characteristic of the element 原子光谱

atomic structure.meaning: n. the structure of an atom as being a central positively charged nucleus surrounded by negatively charged orbiting electrons 原子结构

atomic theory.meaning: n. 1. Physics the theory that atoms are composed of subatomic particles 【物理学】 （主张原子是由更小原子微粒组成的）原子理论 2. the theory that all matter is made up of tiny indivisible particles called atoms, and esp. that the atoms of any one element are identical but differ from those of other elements and unite to form compounds in fixed proportions (认为物质是由基本粒子原子组成，每一元素所有原子都相同，但与其他元素不同，并可按一定比例构成复合元素的）原子理论 3. Philos. atomism 【哲】 原子论，原子说

be.meaning: abbr. [缩略] 1. Bachelor of Education 教育学士 2. Bachelor of Engineering 工学士 3. bill of exchange 汇票 Be symb. Chem. the element beryllium [符] 【化】 （化学元素）铍 be /bi:/ v. & v. aux. (sing. present am /æm, əm/; are /ɑ:, ə/; is /iz/; pl. present are ; 1st and 3rd sing. past was /wɒz, wəz/; 2nd sing. past and pl. past were /wɜ:, wə/; present subjunctive be ; past subjunctive were ; pres. part. being ; past part. been /bi:n, bin/) v. intr. 1. (often prec. by 常前接 there) exist; live 存在，活着 ◊ I think, therefore I am 我思故我在 ◊ there once was a man 从前有一个人 ◊ there is a house on the corner 街角有一幢房子 ◊ there was no doubt 没有疑问 2. a. occur; take place 出现，发生 ◊ dinner is at eight 宴会在 8 点举行 b. occupy a position in space 占据，在 ◊ he is in the garden 他在花园里 ◊ have you been to Paris? 你去过巴黎吗？ 3. remain, continue 仍然，继续 ◊ let it be 随它去 4. linking subject and predicate, expressing 连接主语和表语，表示 : a. identity 身份 ◊ she is the person 她就是这种人 ◊ today is Thursday 今天是星期四 b. condition 状况 ◊ he is ill today 他今天病了 c. state or quality 状态，性质 ◊ he is very kind 他很慈祥 ◊ they are my friends 他们是我的朋友 d. opinion 看法 ◊ I am against hanging 我反对绞刑 e. total 总数 ◊ two and two are four 2 加 2 等于 4 f. cost or significance 费用；意义 ◊ it is £ 5 to enter 要进去得花 5 英镑 ◊ it is nothing to me 此事于我无足轻重 v. aux. 1. with a past participle to form the passive mood 与过去分词组成被动语态 ◊ it was done 做完了 ◊ it is said 据说 ◊ we shall be helped 我们将会得到帮助 2. with a present participle to form continuous tenses 与现在分词组成进行时 ◊ we are coming 我们来了 ◊ it is being cleaned 它正在被打扫 3. with an infinitive to express duty or commitment, intention, possibility, destiny, or hypothesis 与不定式连用，表示责任（许诺、打算、可能、命中注定、假设) ◊ I am to tell you 我应该告诉你 ◊ we are to wait here 我们约定在这儿等 ◊ he is to come at four 他打算在 4 点钟来 ◊ it was not to be found 不可能找到它 ◊ they were never to meet again 他们决不会再见面 ◊ if I were to die 我要是去死的话 4. archaic with the past participle of intransitive verbs to form perfect tenses [古义]与不及物动词的过去分词连用构成完成时 ◊ the sun is set 太阳落了 ◊ Babylon is fallen 巴比伦王国已湮灭 Phr & Deriv: be about occupy oneself with 正忙于 ◊ is about his business 正忙他的事 be at occupy oneself with 正忙于 ◊ what is he at? 他正在忙什么？ ◊ mice have been at the food 老鼠正吃东西 been (or been and gone ) and slang an expression of protest or surprise [俚语]竟然（表示抗议或吃惊) ◊ he's been and taken my car! 他竟然开走了我的车！ be off colloq. go away; leave [口]走开，离开 be that as it may see 见 MAY -to-be of the future 未来的 in comb. 用于复合词 : ◊ bride-to-be 未来的新娘

be a bundle of nerves.meaning: (or prejudices etc.) be extremely nervous (or prejudiced etc.) 神经极度紧张的（偏见极大的等） See main entry at bundle ----> bundle /ˈbʌnd(ə)l/ n. & v. n. 1. a collection of things tied or fastened together 捆，束，包 2. a set of nerve fibres etc. banded together （神经纤维等的）束 3. slang a large amount of money [俚语]一大笔钱 v. 1. tr. (usu. foll. by 通常后跟 up) tie in or make into a bundle 把…扎成一捆（或一包) ◊ bundled up my squash kit 把我的壁球袋扎好 2. tr. (usu. foll. by 通常后跟 into) throw or push, esp. quickly or confusedly (尤指快而胡乱地）把…随便扔在一起；把…塞（或堆）一起 ◊ bundled the papers into the drawer 把文件胡乱塞在抽屉里 3. tr. (usu. foll. by 通常后跟 out, off, away, etc.) send (esp. a person) away hurriedly or unceremoniously 把（尤指某人）推出去；匆匆把（某人）打发走；撵走 ◊ bundled them off the premises 把他们从经营场地打发走 4. tr. (foll. by 后跟 with) (usu. as 通常作 bundled adj. ) Computing sell as a package with 【计算】 与…搭配（或捆绑）销售 ◊ training is bundled with the software 买此软件可得到免费培训 5. intr. sleep clothed with another person, esp. a fiancé(e), as a local custom 与未婚妻（夫）和衣同睡一床（一种地方风俗） Phr & Deriv: be a bundle of nerves (or prejudices etc.) be extremely nervous (or prejudiced etc.) 神经极度紧张的（偏见极大的等） bundle up dress warmly or cumbersomely 穿得暖和（或臃肿） go a bundle on Brit. slang be very fond of [英] [俚语]十分喜爱 bundler n.

be a law unto oneself.meaning: do what one feels is right; disregard custom 独断独行；无视习俗 See main entry at law ----> law /lɔ:/ n. 1. a. a rule enacted or customary in a community and recognized as enjoining or prohibiting certain actions and enforced by the imposition of penalties 法律，法令，法规 b. a body of such rules (总的，成套的）法律，法令，法规 ◊ the law of the land 土地法 ◊ forbidden under Scots law 受到苏格兰法律禁止的 2. the controlling influence of laws; a state of respect for laws 法律的制约；法律尊严 ◊ law and order 法治 3. laws collectively as a social system or subject of study 法律体系，法治体系；法学 ◊ was reading law 在读法律 4. (with defining word 与限定词连用) any of the specific branches or applications of law 特定领域的法规（或运用) ◊ commercial law 商贸法 ◊ law of contract 合同法 5. binding force or effect (法律的）约束力（或效力) ◊ their word is law 他们的话就是法律 6. (prec. by 前接 the) a. the legal profession 法律行业 b. colloq. the police [口]警察 7. the statute and common law 成文法；普通法 (opp. 反义 EQUITY 2) 8. (in pl. 用复数) jurisprudence 法律学 9. a. the judicial remedy; litigation 司法补救；诉讼 b. the law courts as providing this 法院，法庭 ◊ go to law 打官司 10. a rule of action or procedure, e.g. in a game, social context, form of art, etc. (如在游戏、社会场合、艺术形式等中的）规则，守则，惯例 11. a regularity in natural occurrences, esp. as formulated or propounded in particular instances (尤指公式化的或以特殊例子提出的）定律，定理，法则，规律 ◊ the laws of nature 自然法则 ◊ the law of gravity 引力定律 ◊ Parkinson's law 帕金森定律 12. a. the body of divine commandments as expressed in the Bible or other sources (《圣经》等中的）戒律 b. (作 Law of Moses ) the precepts of the Pentateuch 五经，摩西五经（《圣经·旧约》的首五卷) c. (作 the Law ) the Pentateuch as distinguished from the other parts of the Hebrew Bible (the Prophets and the Writings) 五经（有别于《希伯来圣经》的其他部分——先知书和圣徒传) Cf. 参见 TORAH Phr & Deriv: at (or in ) law according to the laws 根据法律 be a law unto oneself do what one feels is right; disregard custom 独断独行；无视习俗 go to law take legal action; make use of the law courts 打官司，上法庭，起诉 lay down the law be dogmatic or authoritarian 武断；发号施令 take the law into one's own hands redress a grievance by one's own means, esp. by force 不顾法律自行处理冤情（尤指诉诸武力）

be a man.meaning: be courageous; not show fear 勇敢的，无畏的 See main entry at man ----> man /mæn/ n. & v. n. ( pl. men /men/) 1. an adult human male, esp. as distinct from a woman or boy (区别于妇女或儿童的成年）男子，男人 2. a. a human being; a person 人；任何人 ◊ no man is perfect 人无完人 b. human beings in general; the human race (泛指）人；人类 ◊ man is mortal 人终有一死 3. a person showing characteristics associated with males 男子汉，大丈夫 ◊ she's more of a man than he is 她比他更像个男人 4. a. a usu. male worker or employee (通常指男）雇工，（男）雇员 ◊ the manager spoke to the men 经理对雇员们讲话 b. esp. Brit. a manservant or valet [尤英]男佣；男仆 c. hist. a vassal [史义]封臣 5. a. (usu. in pl. 通常用复数) soldiers, sailors, etc., esp. non-officers (尤指无官职的）士兵，水手 ◊ was in command of 200 men 指挥着 200 名士兵 b. an individual, usu. male, person （通常指男性）个人 ◊ fought to the last man 战斗到最后一个人 c. (usu. prec. by 通常前接 the, or poss. pron. ) a person regarded as suitable or appropriate in some way; a person fulfilling requirements 最合适的人，最需要的人 ◊ I'm your man 我是你需要的人 ◊ not the man for the job 不适合做这项工作的人 6. a. a husband 丈夫 ◊ man and wife (结为）夫妇 b. colloq. a boyfriend or lover [口]男朋友，情夫 7. a. a human being of a specified historical period or character 特定历史时期的人；某种性格的人 ◊ Renaissance man 文艺复兴时期的人 b. a type of prehistoric human named after the place where the remains were found 根据发现地所命名的史前人 ◊ Peking man 北京猿人 8. any one of a set of pieces used in playing chess, draughts, etc. (国际象棋、跳棋等的）棋子 9. (as second element in comb. 用于复合词中作为第二个要素) a man of a specified nationality, profession, skill, etc. 具有（某籍贯、职业、技能等）的人 ◊ Dutchman 荷兰人 ◊ clergyman 牧师 ◊ horseman 骑手 ◊ gentleman 绅士 10. a. an expression of impatience etc. used in addressing a male （对男人不耐烦等的称呼语）喂 ◊ nonsense, man! 喂，你胡说！ b. colloq. a general mode of address [口] (一般称呼语）朋友，你 ◊ blew my mind, man! 喂，朋友，你真让我糊涂！ 11. (prec. by 前接 a) a person; one 某人 ◊ what can a man do? 人能做什么呢？ 12. a person pursued; an opponent etc. (被追捕的）人；对手（等) ◊ the police have so far not caught their man 警察至今未抓到要抓的人 13. ( the Man ) US slang [美] [俚语] a. the police 警察 b. black slang a person or group with power or authority [黑人俚语]头，上司，领导，老板 14. (in comb. 用于复合词) a ship of a specified type …船，…舰 ◊ merchantman 商船 ◊ Indiaman 大商船 v. tr. ( manned , manning ) 1. supply (a ship, fort, factory, etc.) with a person or people for work or defence etc. 给（船只、要塞、工厂等）配置人员（兵员等） 2. work or service or defend (a specified piece of equipment, a fortification, etc.) 担任（职务），工作在（岗位），防御（要塞) ◊ man the pumps 操作水泵 3. Naut. place men at (a part of a ship) 【海】 为（船的某部位）配备水手 4. fill (a post or office) 使担任（职、位) 5. (usu. 通常作 refl. ) fortify the spirits or courage of 增强勇气，振作精神 ◊ manned herself for the task 她振作精神去承担这一任务 Phr & Deriv: as one man in unison; in agreement 全体地；一致地 be a man be courageous; not show fear 勇敢的，无畏的 be one's own man 1. be free to act; be independent 自主的，独立的 2. be in full possession of one's faculties etc. （因才能等）胸有成竹 man and boy from childhood 从小到大，从童年时代以来，整个一生 man enough sufficiently manly 够男子气概的 man to man with candour; honestly 坦率的，真诚的 men's (or men's room ) a usu. public lavatory for men （通常公共的）男厕所 my (or my good ) man a patronizing mode of address to a man (含优越感地对其他男人的称呼方式）喂；我的好人 separate (or sort out ) the men from the boys colloq. find those who are truly manly, competent, etc. [口]找出真正有魄力（成熟、能干等）的人 to a man all without exception 无例外地，一致地 manless adj.

be a question of time.meaning: be certain to happen sooner or later 是件迟早会发生的事 See main entry at question ----> question /ˈkwestʃ(ə)n/ n. & v. n. 1. a sentence worded or expressed so as to seek information 问题 2. a. doubt about or objection to a thing's truth, credibility, advisability, etc. 疑问 ◊ allowed it without question 不容置疑 ◊ is there any question as to its validity? 对其合法性是否还有怀疑？ b. the raising of such doubt etc. 产生疑问，质疑 3. a matter to be discussed or decided or voted on 议题 4. a problem requiring an answer or solution 待解决的问题 5. (foll. by 后跟 of) a matter or concern depending on conditions (依赖条件的）难事；难题 ◊ it's a question of money 这是个有关钱的问题 v. tr. 1. ask questions of; interrogate 问；询问 2. subject (a person) to examination 盘问，审问，质问（某人） 3. throw doubt upon; raise objections to 怀疑；对…表示疑问；对…提出疑议 4. seek information from the study of (phenomena, facts) (通过现象、事实等进行）分析，探究，研究 Phr & Deriv: be a question of time be certain to happen sooner or later 是件迟早会发生的事 beyond all question undoubtedly 毫无疑问，一定，当然 come into question be discussed; become of practical importance 成为问题；变得具有实际重要性 in question that is being discussed or referred to 讨论中的，争议中的，成问题的，考虑中的 ◊ the person in question 正讨论的那个人 is not the question is irrelevant 无关的 no question of no possibility of 不可能的 ◊ there's no question of my giving in 我绝不可能让步 out of the question too impracticable etc. to be worth discussing; impossible 不予考虑的，不值得谈论的，根本不可能的 put the question require supporters and opponents of a proposal to record their votes, divide a meeting 把议题提交表决，提请表决 questioner n. questioningly adv. questionless adj.

(often foll. by 常后跟 to, or to + infin.) consent 赞同，赞成 ◊ agreed to the arrangement 赞同所做的安排 ◊ agreed to go 同意前往 3. intr. Gram. have the same number, gender, case, or person as 【语法】 保持（人称、性、数、格的）一致 4. tr. Brit. reach agreement about [英]商定，达成一致 ◊ agreed a price 达成一个价格 5. tr. Brit. consent to or approve of (terms, a proposal, etc.) [英]同意，赞同（条款、建议等) 6. tr. Brit. bring (things, esp. accounts) into harmony [英]使（尤指账目）一致；使和谐 7. intr. (foll. by 后跟 on) decide by mutual consent 经一致同意后决定 ◊ agreed on a compromise 协商后同意妥协 Phr & Deriv: agree to differ leave a difference of opinion unresolved 同意保留不同意见 be agreed have reached the same opinion 达成一致意见

be all thumbs.meaning: be clumsy with one's hands 手指不灵巧；笨手笨脚 See main entry at thumb ----> thumb /θʌm/ n. & v. n. 1. a. a short thick terminal projection on the human hand, set lower and apart from the other four and opposable to them （人手的）拇指 b. a digit of other animals corresponding to this 动物的第一指（与人手拇指相对应） 2. the part of a glove etc. intended to cover the thumb （手套等的）拇指部分 v. 1. tr. wear or soil (pages etc.) with a thumb 用拇指翻旧或翻脏（书页等) ◊ a well-thumbed book 一本翻得很旧的书 2. intr. turn over pages with or as with a thumb 用拇指翻页；迅速翻阅 ◊ thumbed through the directory 用拇指迅速翻阅通讯录 3. tr. request or obtain (a lift in a passing vehicle) by signalling with a raised thumb 竖起拇指向过路汽车要求（搭乘便车） 4. tr. use the thumb in a gesture 用拇指示意 Phr & Deriv: be all thumbs be clumsy with one's hands 手指不灵巧；笨手笨脚 thumb one's nose = cock a snook (see 见 SNOOK 1 ) thumbs down an indication of rejection or failure 否定，否决；放弃 thumbs up an indication of satisfaction or approval 满意；同意，赞同 under a person's thumb completely dominated by a person 完全受制于某人 thumbed adj. (also in comb. 亦用于复合词) thumbless adj.

(foll. by 后跟 against, at, on, etc.) a. pound or knock repeatedly (反复地）敲打，击打 ◊ waves beat against the shore 大浪拍岸 ◊ beat at the door 拍打门 b. = beat down 3 3. tr. a. overcome; surpass; win a victory over 克服；超过；战胜 b. complete an activity before (another person etc.) 先于（他人等）完成 c. be too hard for; perplex 难倒；使困惑不解 4. tr. (often foll. by 常后跟 up) stir (eggs etc.) vigorously into a frothy mixture 打，搅（鸡蛋）成泡沬 5. tr. (often foll. by 常后跟 out) fashion or shape (metal etc.) by blows 锤打（金属等） 6. intr. (of the heart, a drum, etc.) pulsate rhythmically (心脏）跳动；（鼓等）被击打 7. tr. (often foll. by 常后跟 out) a. indicate (a tempo or rhythm) by gestures, tapping, etc. 表示韵律（敲出节拍等） b. sound (a signal etc.) by striking a drum or other means 击打以发出（信号等) ◊ beat a tattoo 敲击归营鼓 8. a. intr. (of a bird's wings) move up and down (鸟翅膀）扑动，拍打 b. tr. cause (wings) to move in this way 使（翅膀）扑动 9. tr. make (a path etc.) by trampling 踩出（一条路等） 10. tr. strike (bushes etc.) to rouse game 拍打（草丛等）以惊出猎物 11. intr. Naut. sail in the direction from which the wind is blowing 【海】 逆风行驶 n. 1. a. a main accent or rhythmic unit in music or verse (音乐、诗歌中的）强音；节拍 ◊ three beats to the bar 一节三拍 ◊ missed a beat and came in early 快了一拍 b. the indication of rhythm by a conductor's movements 打拍子 ◊ watch the beat 看拍子 c. (in popular music) a strong rhythm （流行音乐的）强节奏 d. (作 attrib. ) characterized by a strong rhythm 强节奏的 ◊ beat music 强节奏音乐 2. a. a stroke or blow (e.g. on a drum) （如鼓的）一击 b. a measured sequence of strokes 连续拍击 ◊ the beat of the waves on the rocks 波浪不停地拍打着岩石 c. a throbbing movement or sound 跳动，跳动声 ◊ the beat of his heart 他的心跳 3. a. a route or area allocated to a police officer etc. (警官等的）巡逻路线（或范围） b. a person's habitual round 人的习惯行径 4. Physics a pulsation due to the combination of two sounds or electric currents of similar but not equivalent frequencies 【物理学】 拍音，悸音，差拍 5. colloq. [口] = BEATNIK adj. 1. (作 predic. ) slang exhausted, tired out [俚语]极其疲惫的，筋疲力尽的 2. (作 attrib. ) of the beat generation or its philosophy 垮掉一代的；垮掉一代哲学的 Phr & Deriv: beat about (often foll. by 常后跟 for) search (for an excuse etc.) 寻找（借口等） beat about (or US [美] around ) the bush discuss a matter without coming to the point 不直截了当地，转弯抹角地 beat the bounds Brit. mark parish boundaries by striking certain points with rods [英]打边界列队游行 beat one's breast strike one's chest in anguish or sorrow 捶胸顿足 beat the clock complete a task within a stated time 按时完成任务 beat down 1. a. bargain with (a seller) to lower the price 杀（卖主的）价 b. cause a seller to lower (the price) 使降低（价格） 2. strike (a resisting object) until it falls 敲落，击倒（阻碍之物) ◊ beat the door down 把门击倒 3. (of the sun, rain, etc.) radiate heat or fall continuously and vigorously (太阳）强烈照射，（雨）倾盆而下 beat the drum for publicize, promote 宣传，提倡 beaten at the post defeated at the last moment 在最后一刻被击败 beat in crush 砸碎 beat it slang go away [俚语]溜掉 beat off drive back (an attack etc.) 击退（进攻等） beat a retreat withdraw; abandon an undertaking 撤退，打退堂鼓 beat time indicate or follow a musical tempo with a baton or other means 打拍子，按节奏 beat a person to it arrive or achieve something before another person 比别人先完成 beat up give a beating to, esp. with punches and kicks 痛打（尤指拳打脚踢） it beats me I do not understand (it) （这）我不懂 beatable adj.

( longer /ˈlɒŋɡə/; longest /ˈlɒŋɡist/) 1. by or for a long time 很久地，长期地 ◊ long before …之前很久 ◊ long ago 很久以前 ◊ long live the king! 国王万岁！ 2. (as 作 known adj. ) a. publicly acknowledged 公认（的），已知（的) ◊ a known thief 公认的贼 ◊ a known fact 既成事实 b. Math. (of a quantity etc.) having a value that can be stated 【数】 （数量等）已知（的） 7. intr. have understanding or knowledge 确知；了解；知情 8. tr. archaic have sexual intercourse with [古义]与…性交 n. (in phr. 用于短语 in the know ) colloq. well informed; having special knowledge [口]知情的，熟知内幕的；消息灵通的 Phr & Deriv: all one knows (or knows how ) 1. all one can 全部力量，尽其所能 ◊ did all he knew to stop it 尽他全部力量阻止它 2. adv. to the utmost of one's power 竭尽全力地，尽一切可能地 ◊ tried all she knew 竭尽全力地尝试 before one knows where one is with baffling speed 瞬息之间 be not to know 1. have no way of learning 没办法知道 ◊ wasn't to know they'd arrive late 不知道他们会来晚了 2. be not to be told 不被告知 ◊ she's not to know about the party 她没听说过聚会的事 don't I know it! colloq. an expression of rueful assent [口] (表示不乐意的认可）就算我知道 don't you know colloq. or joc. an expression used for emphasis [口] [诙] (表示强调）你也知道 ◊ such a bore, don't you know 你也知道，那是多么乏味的事 for all (or aught ) I know so far as my knowledge extends 据我所知 have been known to have occasionally in the past 过去偶尔也会 ◊ they have been known to turn up late 他们过去偶尔也会迟到 I knew it! I was sure that this would happen 我早就知道事情会这样 I know what I have a new idea, suggestion, etc. 我有个主意（建议等） know about have information about 知道…情况；了解 know best be or claim to be better informed etc. than others (消息等）最知底细，最在行 know better than (foll. by 后跟 that, or to + infin.) be wise, well informed, or well-mannered enough to avoid (specified behaviour etc.) 有头脑，明事理（而避免某行为等） know by name 1. have heard the name of 只闻其名 2. be able to give the name of 叫得出…的名字 know by sight recognize the appearance (only) of （只是）面熟 know how know the way to do something 懂得怎么做（某事） know of be aware of; have heard of 知道有，听说过 ◊ not that I know of 据我所知并非如此 know one's own mind be decisive, not vacillate 有决断，不犹豫；有自己明确的想法 know the ropes (or one's stuff ) be fully knowledgeable or experienced 懂行，在行；精通业务 know a thing or two be experienced or shrewd 很有经验；精明能干 know what's what have adequate knowledge of the world, life, etc. 懂行；老练；通晓世事（生活等） know who's who be aware of who or what each person is 知道谁是谁；熟悉每一个人的情况 not know that ... colloq. be fairly sure that ... not [口]知道…不 ◊ I don't know that I want to go 我知道我不想去 not know what hit one be suddenly injured, killed, disconcerted, etc. 突受伤害；突遭杀害（感到仓慌失措等） not want to know refuse to take any notice of 对…不感兴趣；不予理睬 what do you know (or know about that ) ? colloq. an expression of surprise [口] (表示惊讶）你看怪不怪？真想不到！ you know colloq. before one's time.meaning: prematurely 过早，早熟 ◊ old before his time 他显老 See main entry at time ----> time /taim/ n. & v. n. 1. the indefinite continued progress of existence, events, etc., in past, present, and future regarded as a whole 时，时间（过去、现在和将来连绵不断的整体) 2. a. the progress of this as affecting persons or things （影响人或事物进程的）时间 ◊ stood the test of time 经受时间的考验 b. (prec. by 前接 a) an indefinite period （不明确的）一段时间 ◊ waited for a time 等一会儿 7. time or an amount of time as reckoned by a conventional standard (按习惯标准计算出的）时间；规定的时间 ◊ the time allowed is one hour 所允许的时间是 1 个小时 ◊ ran the mile in record time 以创纪录的时间跑完 1 英里 ◊ eight o'clock New York time 纽约时间 8 点 8. a. an occasion 某一次 ◊ last time I saw you 上次我见到你的时候 b. an event or occasion qualified in some way 特定活动所花的时间 ◊ had a good time 度过了一段美好的时光 9. a moment or definite portion of time destined or suitable for a purpose etc. （特定目的的）合适时候 ◊ now is the time to act 现在是行动的时候了 ◊ shall we fix a time? 我们要不要确定一个时间？ 10. (in pl. 用复数) expressing multiplication 倍数 ◊ is four times as old 年龄要大 3 倍 ◊ five times six is thirty 5 乘以 6 等于 30 11. a lifetime 生命时间，终生时间 ◊ will last my time 会延续我的生命 12. (in sing. or pl. 用单数或复数) a. the conditions of life or of a period 生命期；时期；时代 ◊ hard times 艰难时期 ◊ times have changed 时代已经变了 b. (esp. in phr. 尤用于短语 call time 中) a. Brit. the moment at which the opening hours of a public house end [英]酒店歇业时间 b. (of a priest etc.) pronounce words, esp. in a religious rite, to confer or invoke divine favour upon; ask God to look favourably on (尤指牧师、神父等在宗教仪式上祝福）使神圣；为…祈神赐福，为…祈神保佑 ◊ bless this house 愿上帝保佑这所房屋 2. a. consecrate (esp. bread and wine) 把（尤指面包和酒）祝作圣物 b. sanctify by the sign of the cross （划十字）使圣洁 3. call (God) holy; adore 赞美（上帝），对（上帝）感恩 4. attribute one's good fortune to (an auspicious time, one's fate, etc.); thank 把好运归于（吉时、运气等) ◊ bless the day I met her 幸亏是那天我遇到了她 ◊ bless my stars 我真走运呀 5. (usu. in passive; often foll. by 常后跟 with) make happy or successful 使幸福；使昌盛 ◊ blessed with children 有孩子真福气 ◊ they were truly blessed 他们真是幸运 6. euphem. curse; damn [婉]谴责，咒骂，诅咒 ◊ bless the boy! 这孩子该死！ Phr & Deriv: (God) bless me (or my soul ) an exclamation of surprise, pleasure, indignation, etc. 哎呀，我的天哪（表示惊讶、快乐、愤慨等) (God) bless you! 1. an exclamation of endearment, gratitude, etc. (表示爱抚、感激等）愿上帝保佑你（你们）；请多保重 2. an exclamation made to a person who has just sneezed 长命百岁（在别人打喷嚏时说） I'm (or well, I'm ) blessed (or blest ) an exclamation of surprise etc. 哎呀，我的天哪（表示惊讶） not have a penny to bless oneself with be impoverished 贫无立锥之地，一文不名

bless me.meaning: (God) bless me (or my soul ) an exclamation of surprise, pleasure, indignation, etc. 哎呀，我的天哪（表示惊讶、快乐、愤慨等) See main entry at bless

bless you!.meaning: (God) bless you! 1. an exclamation of endearment, gratitude, etc. (表示爱抚、感激等）愿上帝保佑你（你们）；请多保重 2. an exclamation made to a person who has just sneezed 长命百岁（在别人打喷嚏时说） See main entry at bless

blessed.meaning: adj. (also poet. [亦诗] blest /blest/) 1. a. consecrated 祭神用的，献神的 ◊ Blessed Sacrament 圣餐礼 b. revered 神圣的，受尊敬的 2. /blest/ (usu. foll. by 通常后跟 with) often iron. [常讽] fortunate (in the possession of) (因拥有…而）幸运的，幸福的 ◊ blessed with good health 有幸身体健康 ◊ blessed with children 有孩子真福气 3. euphem. cursed; damned [婉]该诅咒的，该死的 ◊ blessed nuisance! 该死的讨厌鬼！ 4. a. in paradise 享受天国之福的 b. RC Ch. a title given to a dead person, esp. one formally beatified, as an acknowledgement of his or her holy life 【天主教】 （尤指正式行过宣福礼的人）被教会宣布死后已升天的 5. bringing happiness; blissful 给人愉快（或满足）的；使人有福的 ◊ blessed ignorance 难得糊涂 Phr & Deriv: blessedly adv.

(of the wind or air, or impersonally) move along; act as an air current (风、空气或非人格化的东西）吹，吹动 ◊ it was blowing hard 风刮得很紧 b. intr. be driven by an air current 被吹动，流动 ◊ waste paper blew along the gutter 废纸被风吹得沿沟飘动 c. tr. drive with an air current 随风吹动 ◊ blew the door open 把门吹开了 2. a. tr. send out (esp. air) by breathing 吹，喷（尤指气) ◊ blew cigarette smoke 吐烟雾 ◊ blew a bubble 吹泡泡 b. intr. send a directed air current from the mouth 喘气 3. tr. & intr. sound or be sounded by blowing 吹响，吹奏 ◊ the whistle blew 汽笛鸣响 ◊ they blew the trumpets 他们吹着喇叭 4. tr. a. direct an air current at 吹，向…吹气 ◊ blew the embers 把余烬吹着 b. (foll. by 后跟 off, away, etc.) clear by means of an air current 吹气把…弄干净，吹掉 ◊ blew the dust off 把灰尘吹掉 5. tr. (past part. blowed ) (esp. in imper. 尤用于祈使句) Brit. slang curse, damn [英] [俚语]责骂，诅咒 ◊ blow it! 混蛋！ ◊ I'll be blowed! 我真该死！ ◊ let's take a taxi and blow the expense 咱们乘出租吧，管它花多少钱呢 6. tr. a. clear (the nose) of mucus by blowing 擤（鼻子） b. remove contents from (an egg) by blowing through it 吹气把（鸡蛋）弄出来 7. a. intr. puff, pant 喷气，喘气 b. tr. (esp. in passive 尤用于被动) exhaust of breath 呼吸困难 8. slang [俚语] a. tr. depart suddenly from 突然离开 ◊ blew the town yesterday 昨天突然离开这个镇 b. intr. depart suddenly 突然离去 9. tr. shatter or send flying by an explosion 炸开，炸飞 ◊ the bomb blew the tiles off the roof 炸弹把屋顶上的瓦片炸飞了 ◊ blew them to smithereens 把他们炸得粉碎 10. tr. make or shape (glass or a bubble) by blowing air in 吹制（玻璃器皿）；吹（泡）泡 11. tr. & intr. melt or cause to melt from overloading (因过载）烧断，烧坏 ◊ the fuse has blown 保险丝烧断了 12. intr. (of a whale) eject air and water through a blowhole （鲸等）喷水 13. tr. break into (a safe etc.) with explosives 炸开（保险箱等） 14. tr. slang [俚语] a. squander, spend recklessly 挥霍，糟蹋 ◊ blew £ 20 on a meal 一顿饭就花了 20 英镑 b. spoil, bungle (an opportunity etc.) 浪费掉，放过（机会等）；笨手笨脚地做 ◊ he's blown his chances of winning 他失掉了获胜的机会 c. reveal (a secret etc.) 显露，泄露（秘密等） 15. intr. (of a food-tin etc.) swell and eventually burst from internal gas pressure (罐头食品等）膨胀，隆起；炸开 16. tr. work the bellows of (an organ) 演奏（风琴） 17. tr. (of flies) deposit eggs in （苍蝇）产卵 n. 1. a. an act of blowing (e.g. one's nose, a wind instrument) 擤（鼻子）；吹奏（管乐器） b. colloq. a turn or spell of playing jazz (on any instrument); a musical session [口] (用任何乐器）演奏的一曲爵士乐；一段乐曲 2. a. a gust of wind or air 一阵风 b. exposure to fresh air 透透风，呼吸新鲜空气 Phr & Deriv: be blowed if one will slang be unwilling to [俚语]不愿干… blow away slang [俚语] 1. kill, destroy, defeat 杀死，消灭，击败 2. astound, amaze 使惊呆，吃惊 blow the gaff Brit. reveal a secret inadvertently [英]泄露秘密 blow hot and cold colloq. vacillate [口]冷热无常，出尔反尔，摇摆不定 blow in 1. break inwards by an explosion 向内炸开 2. colloq. arrive unexpectedly [口]突然到来 blow a kiss kiss one's hand and wave"it to a distant person 送（某人）飞吻 blow a person's mind slang cause a person to have drug-induced hallucinations or a similar experience [俚语]使某人产生吸毒引起的幻觉（或类似的感觉） blow off 1. escape or allow (steam etc.) to escape forcibly (使) (蒸气等）喷出，冲出 2. slang break wind noisily [俚语]大声放屁 blow on (or upon ) 1. expose 揭露，暴露 2. discredit 使名誉扫地 blow out 1. a. extinguish by blowing 吹灭，吹息 b. send outwards by an explosion 向外炸开 2. (of a tyre) burst (车胎）爆裂，放炮 3. (of a fuse etc.) melt （保险丝等）烧断 4. N. Amer. slang [北美] [俚语] a. defeat convincingly 彻底打败 b. render useless, break 使残废，折断 ◊ he blew out his arm 他断了胳膊 blow over (of trouble etc.) fade away without serious consequences (麻烦等）逝去，被淡忘 blow one's own trumpet praise oneself 自吹自擂 blow one's socks off see 见 SOCK 1 blow one's top (N. Amer. also [北美亦] stack ) colloq. explode in rage [口]大发雷霆 blow up 1. a. shatter or destroy by an explosion 炸飞，炸毁 b. explode, erupt 爆炸，暴发 2. Brit. colloq. rebuke strongly [英口]严责，痛斥 3. inflate (a tyre etc.) （给车胎等）充气 4. colloq. [口] a. enlarge (a photograph) 放大（照片） b. exaggerate 夸大，对…言过其实 5. colloq. come to notice; arise [口]引起注意，使出现 6. colloq. lose one's temper [口]大发脾气 blow the whistle on see 见 WHISTLE blow 2 /bləʊ/ n. 1. a hard stroke with a hand or weapon (用手、武器的）一击，捶打 2. a sudden shock or misfortune 突然的打击；灾祸，不幸 Phr & Deriv: at one blow by a single stroke; in one operation 一击之下，一下子 come to blows end up fighting 动手打起来，开始互殴 strike a blow for (or against ) show support for (or opposition to) 支持（或反对）… blow 3 /bləʊ/ v. & n. archaic [古义] v. intr. (past blew /blu:/; past part. blown /bləʊn/) burst into or be in flower (花）开，开花 n. blossoming, bloom 开花；花 ◊ in full blow 盛开

blow a fuse.meaning: lose one's temper 勃然大怒 See main entry at fuse ----> fuse 1 /fju:z/ v. & n. v. 1. tr. & intr. melt with intense heat; liquefy (使）熔化；（使）液化 2. tr. & intr. blend or amalgamate into one whole by or as by melting (使）熔合，（使）熔接；（使）混合；（使）合并 3. tr. provide (a circuit, plug, etc.) with a fuse 给（电路、插头等）安装保险丝 4. Brit. [英] a. intr. (of an appliance) cease to function when a fuse blows （电器）保险丝熔断时中断工作 b. tr. cause (an appliance) to do this 使（电器）因保险丝熔断而中断工作 n. a device or component for protecting an electric circuit, containing a strip or wire of easily melted metal and placed in the circuit so as to break it by melting when an excessive current passes through 保险丝，熔线 Phr & Deriv: blow a fuse lose one's temper 勃然大怒 fuse 2 /fju:z/ n. & v. (also 亦作 fuze ) n. 1. a device for igniting a bomb or explosive charge, consisting of a tube or cord etc. filled or saturated with combustible matter 导火线，导火索 2. a component in a shell, mine, etc., designed to detonate an explosive charge on impact, after an interval, or when subjected to a magnetic or vibratory stimulation 引信，信管 v. tr. fit a fuse to 给…装引信（或导火线） Phr & Deriv: fuseless adj.

blow a gasket.meaning: slang lose one's temper [俚语]发脾气，发火 See main entry at gasket ----> gasket /ˈɡæskit/ n. 1. a sheet or ring of rubber etc., shaped to seal the junction of metal surfaces 密封垫，密封片，垫圈 2. Naut. a small cord securing a furled sail to a yard 【海】 束帆索 Phr & Deriv: blow a gasket slang lose one's temper [俚语]发脾气，发火

(often in pl. 常用复数) a traffic light 交通信号灯 ◊ went through a red light 穿过红灯 ◊ stop at the lights 在红绿灯前停住 6. a. the amount or quality of illumination in a place 照明度，亮度 ◊ bad light stopped play 光线太差停止比赛 b. one's fair or usual share of this 光线 ◊ you are standing in my light 你站着挡住了我的光线 7. a. a flame or spark serving to ignite (如火焰、火花）导火物 ◊ struck a light 擦火柴 b. a device producing this 点火器 ◊ have you got a light? 你有火儿吗？ 8. the aspect in which a thing is regarded or considered (观察的）角度；眼光；方式 ◊ appeared in a new light 以新的方式出现 9. a. mental illumination; elucidation, enlightenment 启发；解释；开导 b. hope, happiness; a happy outcome 希望，欣喜，欣喜的结果 c. spiritual illumination by divine truth 神理的启迪，神的启示 10. vivacity, enthusiasm, or inspiration visible in a person's face, esp. in the eyes (脸部）快活，热情；鼓舞的表情；（尤指眼中）容光 11. (in pl. 用复数) a person's mental powers or ability 智力；智能 ◊ according to one's lights 根据某人的智能 12. an eminent person 杰出人物，名人 ◊ a leading light 巨星，巨擘 13. a. the bright part of a thing; a highlight (物体的）明亮部分；最显著的部分 b. the bright parts of a picture etc. esp. suggesting illumination （尤指画等的）明亮部分 ◊ light and shade 明亮部分和阴暗部分 14. a. a window or opening in a wall to let light in 窗户；（墙体上的）采光孔 b. the perpendicular division of a mullioned window 直棂窗的竖隔 c. a pane of glass esp. in the side or roof of a greenhouse （尤指暖房四周和房顶的）窗玻璃 15. (often foll. by 常后跟 with) make or be passionate; feel or cause to feel great emotion (使）兴奋；（使）充满炽热的情感 ◊ burn with shame 羞愧难当；羞得面红耳赤 13. intr. slang drive fast [俚语]开快车 14. tr.
